xa: They are held in **September** and **March**.
POSHAN Abhiyaan converges **ICDS**, **NHM** and **Swachh Bharat**.

ncdc31379f2d.s: Under IGNWPS and IGNDPS, the central assistance for beneficiaries aged 80 years and above is:
ncdc31379f2d.x: Both schemes give ₹300 for the lower age group and ₹500 for beneficiaries aged 80 or above.
xa: **NFBS** pays a **₹20,000** lump sum on death of a breadwinner aged **18-59**.
**Annapurna** gives **10 kg** free grain a month.
AP's **NTR Bharosa** pays **₹4,000** a month.

n1d18c88171f.s: The National Pension System was initially introduced from 1 January 2004 for:
o: Central Government employees, excluding the armed forces
Employees of public sector banks only
All citizens of India, including the armed forces
n1d18c88171f.x: NPS was introduced from 1 January 2004 for Central Government employees, with the armed forces excluded.
n1d18c88171f.tq: Focus on the commencement date and the specific exclusion.
xs: NPS began on **1 Jan 2004** for **central government employees, excluding the armed forces** — option **(1)**.
It was opened to **all citizens** only from **1 May 2009**, so option (4) is wrong.
xa: Regulator: **PFRDA** (Act passed **19 Sep 2013**, notified **1 Feb 2014**).
Design: **defined-contribution**; **PRAN**; Tier I mandatory + Tier II voluntary.
Extra **₹50,000** deduction under **80CCD(1B)**.
Scale (31 Mar **2026**): **2.17 crore+** subscribers; AUM about **₹15.95 lakh crore**.

n2965416d58c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the National Pension System (NPS)?
o: It is a defined-contribution pension system
Both Tier I and Tier II accounts are mandatory
An extra deduction of ₹50,000 is available under Section 80CCD(1B)
n2965416d58c.x: Tier I is mandatory but Tier II is voluntary.
xa: An NPS account **cannot be opened or operated for a third person** (**G2-GS 2024** key).
Regulator: **PFRDA**.
NPS began **1 Jan 2004** for central staff; open to all from **1 May 2009**.

nb88d81c5b64.s: Under the Unified Pension Scheme introduced in 2025, an employee completing 25 years of service is entitled to an assured pension equal to:
o: 40% of the last 12 months’ average basic pay
75% of the last 12 months’ average basic pay
50% of the last 12 months’ average basic pay
25% of the last month’s basic pay
nb88d81c5b64.x: UPS provides 50 per cent of the average basic pay of the last 12 months after 25 years of service. The minimum assured pension is ₹10,000.
nb88d81c5b64.tq: Distinguish the percentage, reference period and service requirement.
xs: **UPS (2025)** gives **50%** of the last **12** months' average basic pay after **25** years — option **(3)**.
The minimum assured pension is **₹10,000**.
xa: **NPS** is **defined-contribution**; began **1 Jan 2004**.
**NPS Vatsalya (2025)**: for minors; minimum **₹250**.
⚠ **50%** also = family pension to the spouse under PM-SYM, PM-KMY and NPS-Traders.

n6d93f307d72.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Atal Pension Yojana (APY)?
o: Its eligible entry age is 18 to 60 years
Government support for it has been extended up to FY 2030–31
n6d93f307d72.x: The eligible entry age for APY is 18 to 40 years.
xa: APY assures **₹1,000-5,000** at **60**; administered by **PFRDA**.
**8.96 crore** subscribers; **43.7% CAGR** since **2016** (2025-26).
**PMSBY** and **PMJJBY** were launched on the same day, **9 May 2015**.

nd4e53c3c4d6.s: Under PM-SYM, PM-KMY and NPS-Traders, the family pension payable to the spouse is:
nd4e53c3c4d6.x: The spouse receives 50 per cent of the pension as family pension under PM-SYM, PM-KMY and NPS-Traders.
nd4e53c3c4d6.tq: Test the exact percentage in a family-pension provision.
xs: Family pension under **PM-SYM, PM-KMY and NPS-Traders** is **50%** to the spouse — option **(2)**.
So neither the entire pension nor a smaller share passes on: the notes fix it at **50 per cent**.
xa: All three pay **₹3,000** a month at **60**, with Centre matching.
PM-SYM matching: **₹55** at 18 to **₹200** at 40.
**NPS-Traders** is for turnover **≤₹1.5 crore**; MoLE, **2019**.

n579ed4edb9a.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the benefits associated with EPFO coverage?
o: Unemployment allowance, family benefit and NFSA entitlement
Medical, maternity and dependants' benefits only
Provident fund, EPS pension and EDLI insurance
Old-age pension, maternity benefit and food subsidy only
n579ed4edb9a.x: The principal EPFO-linked benefits are provident fund accumulation, pension under the Employees' Pension Scheme and insurance under EDLI. Medical and maternity benefits are associated with ESI or other social-security provisions.
n579ed4edb9a.tq: Distinguish EPF-linked benefits from ESI benefits.
xs: EPFO benefits are **Provident Fund + EPS pension + EDLI insurance** — option **(3)**.
**Medical, maternity and dependants' benefits** belong to **ESI**, not EPFO.
**NFSA** entitlements and food subsidy are social assistance, not EPF.
xa: EPF: **12%** of wages each; coverage **20+** employees.
Wage ceiling **₹25,000** (was ₹15,000).
**EPF Scheme, 2026** makes **Aadhaar + PAN + UAN** linking mandatory.

n06e318e03f1.s: The National Pension System was introduced for government staff in 2004 and extended to all citizens in:
n06e318e03f1.x: The NPS was introduced for government staff in 2004 and extended to all citizens in 2009.
n06e318e03f1.tq: Discriminate between the two dates attached to the same scheme.
xs: **NPS** was opened to **all citizens** from **1 May 2009** — option **(2)**.
It began on **1 Jan 2004** for central government employees, **armed forces excluded**.
**2007** = Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana; **2015** = PMSBY, PMJJBY, APY; **2019** = PM-SYM, PM-KMY, NPS-Traders.
xa: Regulator: **PFRDA** (Act passed **19 Sep 2013**, notified **1 Feb 2014**).
**Defined-contribution**; Tier I mandatory, Tier II voluntary.
**UPS** and **NPS Vatsalya** came in **2025**.

n47a393aa5dc.s: Which of the following schemes were launched on 9 May 2015?
n47a393aa5dc.x: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana, Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana and Atal Pension Yojana were launched on 9 May 2015.
n47a393aa5dc.tq: Match the launch date with the correct cluster of schemes.
xs: **PMSBY, PMJJBY and APY** were all launched on **9 May 2015** — option **(4)**.
**PM-SYM, PM-KMY, NPS-Traders** = **2019**; **UPS, NPS Vatsalya** = **2025**; **e-Shram** = **26 Aug 2021**.
xa: **APY** replaced **Swavalamban**; entry age **18-40**; pension **₹1,000-5,000** at 60.
APY has **8.96 crore** subscribers.
**PMAY-Urban** and **PMKVY** also date from **2015**.

n06dedba1af2.s: Janani Suraksha Yojana, under the National Health Mission, provides cash assistance for:
n06dedba1af2.x: JSY gives cash assistance for institutional delivery under the NHM and is 100 per cent centrally sponsored.
xa: JSY was launched in **2005**.
**NHM** = **NRHM + NUHM**; **ASHAs + ANMs** are its backbone.
NFSA maternity benefit: **₹6,000**.

n71cde77f874.s: The two sub-missions of the National Health Mission are:
n71cde77f874.x: NHM has two parts, the National Rural Health Mission and the National Urban Health Mission, with ASHAs and ANMs as its backbone.
xa: **Janani Suraksha Yojana** runs under NHM.
POSHAN Abhiyaan converges **ICDS, NHM and Swachh Bharat**.
**37 lakh** ASHAs, AWWs and AW helpers were added to **PM-JAY**.

n79f4f0962f7.s: Ayushman Bharat–PM-JAY was launched in September 2018 at:
n79f4f0962f7.x: PM-JAY, earlier called the National Health Protection Scheme, was launched at Ranchi in September 2018 and subsumed RSBY (2008).
xa: Ministry: **MoHFW**; implemented by the **NHA**.
Cover: **₹5 lakh per family per year**.
Senior expansion (**Oct 2024**): all **70+** — **Ayushman Vay Vandana**.

n894b5ffcb48.s: Under the National Food Security Act, priority households receive ____ of foodgrain per person per month.
n894b5ffcb48.x: Priority households get 5 kg per person per month; AAY households get 35 kg per household, and the maternity benefit is Rs 6,000.
xa: Draft **NFSA (Amendment) Bill 2026**: **7 kg per person** for AAY, capped at **35 kg** per household.
NFSA covers **79.8 crore** people.
The **NFSA** dates from **2013** — a **legal right to food**.

n0c2415151bd.s: The national rollout of One Nation One Ration Card, which makes NFSA benefits portable across India, began in:
xa: It works in **all 36 States/UTs**, with **99.9%** Aadhaar seeding.
⚠ **99.9%** = Aadhaar seeding; **99.8%** = FPS Aadhaar authentication.
Free grain reaches **81.35 crore** people.

ncd0d97a313c.s: POSHAN Abhiyaan brings together ICDS, the National Health Mission and:
ncd0d97a313c.x: POSHAN Abhiyaan converges ICDS, NHM and Swachh Bharat to tackle stunting, under-nutrition, anaemia and low birth weight.
xa: Nodal ministry: **MWCD**.
It targets **stunting, under-nutrition, anaemia, low birth weight**.
Launched **8 March 2018**, **Jhunjhunu**.

n8c175fa9356.s: Social assistance differs from social insurance in that social assistance is:
n8c175fa9356.x: Social assistance is non-contributory, tax-funded and means-tested, while social insurance is contributory and tied to employment and risks.
xa: Social insurance examples: **EPF, ESI, APY, PM-SYM**.
Social assistance examples: **NSAP, NFSA, PM-JAY**.
Proposed model (Aug **2026**): **"contributory + tax-funded"** with a **Universal Social Protection Floor**.

nebdf1944be4.s: ILO Convention No. 102, the Social Security (Minimum Standards) Convention, 1952, sets minimum standards for how many branches of social security?
nebdf1944be4.x: Convention No. 102 covers nine branches of social security; India has not ratified it.
xa: The nine branches: medical care, sickness, unemployment, old age, employment injury, family, maternity, invalidity, survivors.
India's proposed **Universal Social Protection Floor**: health, maternity, disability, old-age, basic income.

nda7eee21828.s: NSAP gives effect to which Directive Principle of State Policy?
nda7eee21828.x: NSAP gives effect to Article 41 of the Directive Principles, relating to public assistance in cases including old age, sickness and disablement.
nda7eee21828.tq: Match the welfare programme with its constitutional provision.
xs: NSAP gives effect to **Article 41** of the DPSP — option **(4)**.
NSAP (**1995**) is a CSS of the **Ministry of Rural Development** for **BPL** households.
xa: About **94%** of NSAP payments are made by **DBT** (May **2026**).
Components: **IGNWPS**, **IGNDPS**, **NFBS**, **Annapurna** (and IGNOAPS).
Criticism: NSAP pension has **not kept up with inflation**.

nea29a577941.s: The National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP), which gives effect to Article 41 of the Constitution, was launched in:
nea29a577941.x: NSAP was launched in 1995 under the Ministry of Rural Development. 1985 is when Indira Awaas Yojana began, 2000 is AAY and Annapurna, and 2005 is JSY/MGNREGA.
xs: **NSAP** was launched in **1995** — option **(2)**.
**1985** = start of **Indira Awaas Yojana**; **2000** = **Antyodaya Anna Yojana and Annapurna**.
xa: NSAP is a CSS of the **Ministry of Rural Development** for **BPL** households.
Chronology: NSAP **1995** → AAY/Annapurna **2000** → NPS **2004** → PMSBY, PMJJBY, APY **9 May 2015** → PM-JAY **Sep 2018**.
**Pulse Polio** also began in **1995**.

n3626727b99a.s: PM-SYM covers unorganised workers earning up to ____ a month.
n3626727b99a.x: PM-SYM's income limit is Rs 15,000 a month; the Centre makes a 1:1 matching contribution.
xa: Pension: **₹3,000** at **60**; family pension **50%** to spouse.
⚠ **₹25,000** is the new **EPF wage ceiling**, not the PM-SYM limit.
Entry age **18-40**.

n263a2d017a2.s: The Employees' Provident Fund generally covers establishments employing ____ or more persons.
n263a2d017a2.x: EPF generally covers establishments with 20 or more employees, with 12% of wages contributed each by employee and employer.
xa: Wage ceiling raised from **₹15,000 to ₹25,000** a month (Cabinet, **17 Sep 2026**).
Benefits: **PF + EPS pension + EDLI insurance**.
**EPF Scheme, 2026** replaced the **EPF Scheme 1952**.

nffa76fd4f32.s: Which of the following is NOT a feature associated with the EPF Scheme, 2026?
o: Voluntary contributions above the prescribed ceiling
Exclusion of Aadhaar, PAN and UAN linkage requirements
Liability of the principal employer for contract workers' provident fund
nffa76fd4f32.x: Linking Aadhaar, PAN and UAN is mandatory under the EPF Scheme, 2026. The other three are stated features of the Scheme.
nffa76fd4f32.tq: Identify the option that reverses a specific compliance requirement.
xs: **Exclusion of Aadhaar, PAN and UAN linkage** is not a feature — option **(3)**; linking is **mandatory**.
Real features: **automatic carry-over** of members, **voluntary contributions above ceiling**, **principal employer liable** for contract workers' PF.
xa: **EPF Scheme, 2026** replaced **EPF Scheme 1952** under the **Code on Social Security**.
Contribution **12%** each (**10%** for notified establishments).
Coverage: establishments with **20+** employees.

ncc2dce77eb2.s: The wage ceiling for mandatory EPFO coverage was raised from ₹15,000 to:
ncc2dce77eb2.x: The mandatory EPFO wage ceiling was raised from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 per month. The earlier ₹15,000 ceiling had been in force since September 2014.
ncc2dce77eb2.tq: Use the exact revised figure rather than the nearby ESI ceiling.
xs: The EPF wage ceiling was raised from **₹15,000 to ₹25,000** a month — option **(2)** (Cabinet, **17 Sep 2026**).
The ₹15,000 ceiling dated from **Sep 2014**; the hike is expected to add **51 lakh+** employees.
**₹21,000** is the **ESI** ceiling — a trap.
xa: ESI contributions: employer **3.25%**, employee **0.75%**.
EPF contribution: **12%** each from employee and employer.
**EPFO** will not reopen the higher-pension window; **4.4 lakh** demand letters issued.

n976fa78921e.s: Under the ESI scheme (wage ceiling ₹21,000 a month), the employer's and employee's contributions are respectively:
n976fa78921e.x: The employer contributes 3.25% and the employee 0.75%, with a wage ceiling of ₹21,000 per month.
xa: ESI rests on the **ESI Act 1948**.
Benefits: medical, sickness, maternity, disablement, dependants'.
**SPREE (Jul 2025-Jan 2026)** added **1.03 crore** employees.
Under the **SS Code**, ESIC coverage is **pan-India**.

ne9e0499ba39.s: The Code on Social Security, 2020 merged how many labour and social-security laws?
ne9e0499ba39.x: The Code on Social Security, 2020 merged nine laws, including laws relating to EPF, ESI, maternity benefit, gratuity and unorganised workers' social security.
xs: The **Code on Social Security, 2020** merged **9 laws** — option **(3)**.
They include **EPF, ESI, Maternity Benefit, Gratuity** and the **Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act**.
**4** is the number of **Labour Codes**, a trap.
xa: The **Four Labour Codes** are in force from **21 Nov 2025**, with **2026** Central Rules.
First legal recognition of **gig workers, platform workers and aggregators**.
Aggregators pay **1-2% of annual turnover** (capped at **5%** of payouts).

ndba0faae592.s: Which body recommends social-security schemes for gig and platform workers under the Code on Social Security framework?
ndba0faae592.x: The National Social Security Board recommends social-security schemes for gig and platform workers under the framework.
ndba0faae592.tq: Ask which institution performs the specific recommending function.
xs: The **National Social Security Board** recommends schemes for gig and platform workers — option **(1)**.
**NHA** implements **PM-JAY**; **EPFO** runs PF, EPS and EDLI.
xa: The Code gives first legal recognition to **gig workers, platform workers and aggregators**.
Aggregators pay **1-2% of annual turnover**, capped at **5%** of payouts, into a social security fund.
**e-Shram (26 Aug 2021)** is the Aadhaar-verified database of unorganised workers.

na18132d488c.s: Under the Code on Social Security, a creche is required in establishments with ____ or more employees.
na18132d488c.x: A creche is required at 50 or more employees; 20 is the EPF coverage threshold.
xa: The Code merged **9 laws**, incl. **Maternity Benefit** and **Gratuity**.
**Four Labour Codes** in force from **21 Nov 2025**.
NFSA maternity benefit is **₹6,000**.

n4be164957fe.s: e-Shram, the Aadhaar-verified National Database of Unorganised Workers, was launched on 26 August 2021 by the Ministry of:
n4be164957fe.x: e-Shram was launched by the Ministry of Labour and Employment and gives a 12-digit UAN; income-tax payers and EPFO/ESIC members are excluded.
xa: **One-Stop Solution (2024)** joins up **15 schemes**.
Registrations: **31.87 crore** (Aug **2026**).
Five years of e-Shram marked in Aug **2026**.

n0ff351f32db.s: All four Labour Codes came into force on
n0ff351f32db.x: All four Labour Codes, including the Code on Social Security, came into force on 21 November 2025, with Central Rules following in 2026. 17 April 2026 and 8 May 2026 are not the commencement date, and 2019 predates the 2020 Code.
n0ff351f32db.tq: Distinguish the commencement date of the Codes from the later notification of rules.
xs: All **Four Labour Codes** came into force on **21 November 2025** — option **(1)**.
The **Central Rules** followed in **2026**; the Code on Social Security itself dates from **2020**, so **2019** is too early.
xa: The **Code on Social Security, 2020** merged **9 laws** (EPF, ESI, Maternity Benefit, Gratuity, etc.).
First legal recognition of **gig workers, platform workers and aggregators**.
Maternity leave stays **26** weeks; creche required at **50+** employees.
**EPF Scheme, 2026** replaced **EPF Scheme 1952** under the Code.

n11912432dd0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Code on Social Security, 2020?
o: It is the first law to recognise aggregators, gig workers and platform workers
There is no cap on the aggregators' contribution
Aggregators must contribute 1–2 per cent of annual turnover to a social-security fund
The contribution is linked to the payments made to workers
n11912432dd0.x: The aggregator contribution is capped at 5 per cent of the payments made to workers.
xa: The **National Social Security Board** recommends schemes for them.
The Code merged **9 laws**; Four Labour Codes in force from **21 Nov 2025**.
**e-Shram** (**26 Aug 2021**) is the database of unorganised workers.

nd6856755548.s: The e-Shram portal was launched in:
nd6856755548.x: e-Shram was launched on 26 August 2021; 2019 is the year of PM-SYM, PM-KMY and NPS-Traders.
xa: PM-JAY subsumed **RSBY (2008)**.
UPS: **50%** of last **12** months' average basic pay after **25** years.
NPS Vatsalya: for minors; minimum **₹250**.

n840bbeacb8a.s: Under Andhra Pradesh's NTR Bharosa scheme, the monthly pension is:
n840bbeacb8a.x: NTR Bharosa provides ₹4,000 per month; AP's Universal Health Policy gives ₹2.5 lakh free cover to all.
xa: NTR Bharosa covers **weavers, fishermen, toddy tappers, artisans, dappu artists**.
AP Budget **2026-27**: JJM **₹4,000 crore**, SBM **₹1,037 crore**.
**Dr NTR Vaidya Seva** is AP's health scheme in the Budget.

n5a60462c305.s: Under PMFBY, the farmer premium for commercial and horticultural crops is:
n5a60462c305.x: The premium is 5% for commercial/horticultural crops, 2% for kharif and 1.5% for rabi.
xa: The premium subsidy is **shared Centre-state**.
**NAIS** dates from **1999-2000**.
⚠ **2016** = PMFBY + **e-NAM**; **2015** = PMKSY + Soil Health Card.

n5c44960bdca.s: PM-KISAN, launched in February 2019, is funded as a:
o: Centrally Sponsored Scheme with a 75:25 share
Centrally Sponsored Scheme with a 90:10 share
Centrally Sponsored Scheme with a 60:40 share
n5c44960bdca.x: PM-KISAN is a 100% Central Sector scheme giving Rs 6,000 a year in three instalments.
xa: ⚠ **PM-KISAN** = ₹6,000 a **year**; **PM Kisan Maandhan** = **₹3,000 a month** pension at 60.
Other Central Sector schemes: **PM Vishwakarma**, **DILRMP** (since **2016**), **SEED**.
**60:40** is the CSS norm (e.g., DAY-NRLM, VB-G RAM G).

nca67b70d842.s: PM-PRANAM, which aims to cut chemical fertiliser use, was launched in:
nca67b70d842.x: PM-PRANAM was launched in 2023; States share the subsidy saved.
xa: **Soil Health Card** (**2015**, **Suratgarh**) gives fertiliser advice per holding.
Other Agriculture Ministry schemes: **Agriculture Infrastructure Fund** and **10,000 FPOs**.

n69217b1a8a3.s: A small or marginal farmer entering the PM Kisan Maandhan scheme at the eligible age receives a pension of ₹3,000 per month on attaining:
n69217b1a8a3.x: PM Kisan Maandhan is a contributory pension scheme providing ₹3,000 per month from the age of 60; entry is permitted between 18 and 40 years.
n69217b1a8a3.tq: Separate the pension age from the scheme's entry-age range.
xs: **PM Kisan Maandhan** pays **₹3,000 a month** on reaching **60 years** — option **(3)**.
It is **contributory**, for small and marginal farmers with entry age **18-40**.
xa: ⚠ **PM-KISAN** = **₹6,000 a year** in 3 instalments (**Feb 2019**).
PM Kisan Maandhan was launched in **2019**.
**Lakhpati Didi** target: **3 crore** women earning over **₹1 lakh** a year.

nc7c37a1a436.s: The Soil Health Card scheme, giving nutrient status and fertiliser advice for each holding, was launched in 2015 at:
nc7c37a1a436.x: The Soil Health Card scheme was launched in 2015 at Suratgarh in Rajasthan.
xa: ⚠ **2015** = PMKSY + Soil Health Card; **2016** = PMFBY + e-NAM.
**PM-PRANAM** (**2023**) aims to cut chemical fertiliser use.
**e-NAM** (April **2016**) lead agency is **SFAC**.

nc429be82419.s: VB-G RAM G, which replaces MGNREGA, guarantees how many days of work per household?
nc429be82419.x: VB-G RAM G raises the guarantee to 125 days and is implemented through Panchayati Raj Institutions.
xa: Funding: CSS **60:40**, NE/Himalayan **90:10**, UT without legislature **100%**.
Total **₹1,51,282 crore**; Centre **₹95,692.31 crore**.
Tagline: **"Rozgar Bhi, Samman Bhi"**.
AP Budget **2026-27** allotted **₹8,365 crore** to it.

n7fe3c91457b.s: Under MGNREGA, at least what share of the workers had to be women?
n7fe3c91457b.x: MGNREGA required one-third of workers to be women; the Gram Sabha ran the social audit.
xa: Guarantee: **100 days** of unskilled manual work per household per year.
MGNREGA is now **repealed**, replaced by **VB-G RAM G** (**125 days**).
CAG audit: planned **Green India Mission-MGNREGS** convergence not achieved.

n9556aaa4b17.s: The National Council for Land Reforms, set up in 2008, is chaired by the:
n9556aaa4b17.x: The National Council for Land Reforms (2008) is chaired by the Prime Minister.
xa: **DILRMP 3.0** guidelines have been issued.
**SVAMITVA** (**24 Apr 2020**): drone survey of village houses + property cards.
⚠ **2020** = SVAMITVA, not the DILRMP change.

n642f2bb4853.s: Under DAY-NRLM, Centre-State funding for North-Eastern States including Sikkim is in the ratio:
n642f2bb4853.x: DAY-NRLM is funded 60:40 generally and 90:10 for NE States including Sikkim; UTs get 100% Central funding.
xa: An older quiz says **75:25** — the original NRLM ratio.
**Delhi** and **Chandigarh** are excluded.
Implemented via **State Rural Livelihood Missions**.

nd2e555d14b8.s: PM SVANidhi is a scheme of the Ministry of:
nd2e555d14b8.x: PM SVANidhi is under MoHUA; PM Vishwakarma is under MSME and PM-AJAY under Social Justice and Empowerment.
xa: PM SVANidhi: first loan **₹10,000**, **7% interest subsidy**, **75 lakh+** vendors.
PM-AJAY's **Adarsh Gram**: villages with **500+** people and over **40%** SC, **₹20 lakh** per village.
PM Vishwakarma: **24.50 lakh** craftspeople trained and given credit.

ncb0115adafb.s: The Adarsh Gram component of PM-AJAY was formerly known as:
ncb0115adafb.x: The Adarsh Gram component was formerly PMAGY (2009-10); it covers villages with 500+ people and over 40% SC population.
xa: Adarsh Gram grant: **₹20 lakh per village**.
**47,300** villages covered; **16,700** declared Adarsh Grams.

naa3e263482a.s: Andhra Pradesh's Amaravati is included under which of the following schemes?
naa3e263482a.x: On the AP side, Amaravati is a HRIDAY city. SPMRM develops Rurban clusters, SVAMITVA does drone surveys of village houses, and PM e-Bus Sewa provides city e-buses.
naa3e263482a.tq: AP angle: Amaravati - HRIDAY; APSSDC - 50 skill hubs.
xs: **Amaravati** is included in **HRIDAY** — option **(2)**.
**SPMRM** develops Rurban clusters; **SVAMITVA** does drone surveys of village houses; **PM e-Bus Sewa** gives **10,000 e-buses**.
xa: AP angle also: **APSSDC** skill hubs (**50** in rural colleges).
⚠ PM-AJAY's Adarsh Gram was formerly **PMAGY**, not HRIDAY.
**Smart Cities Mission (2015)** covers **100 cities**.

nee5c4c6cd49.s: NRLM, restructured from SGSY in 2011, was renamed Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-NRLM in:
nee5c4c6cd49.x: NRLM was restructured from SGSY in 2011 and renamed DAY-NRLM in 2016.
xa: SGSY merged **IRDP, TRYSEM, DWCRA** and allied schemes.

na3986765dc9.s: Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (1989) was formed by merging:

**VB-G RAM G** now replaces **MGNREGA**.

nd2c18efaf1f.s: The VB-G RAM G Act came into force on:

n1beffdac2ec.s: VB-G RAM G is the abbreviated form of:
o: Viksit Bharat—Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)
Viksit Bharat—Gram Rozgar and Awas Mission
Viksit Bharat—Gramin Rehabilitation and Manufacturing Mission
Village Bharat—Guarantee for Rural Agriculture and Migration
n1beffdac2ec.x: VB-G RAM G stands for Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin).

xs: **VB-G RAM G** = **Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)** — option **(1)**.

nda67739feea.s: Under VB-G RAM G, the unemployment allowance and delay compensation are borne by:

nadd2abf7cd0.s: The general Centre-State funding pattern for Centrally Sponsored Schemes is:

n4776266588d.s: SVAMITVA, which uses drone surveys to give property cards for village houses, is a scheme of the Ministry of:

nfc5f14c1a23.s: Which one of the following is NOT a benefit associated with PM Vishwakarma?

Working-capital loans beginning at ₹10,000 for street vendors

nbd42835ac67.s: PM SVANidhi provides working-capital loans, starting at ₹10,000, to:

nfd1d51aacac.x: ONDC is an open network for digital commerce promoted by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).

xs: **ONDC** is promoted by **DPIIT** — option **(3)**.
**MeitY** runs Digital India; **DoT** runs PM-WANI; **SIDBI** manages the startup Fund of Funds.
xa: ONDC scale: **20 crore** buyers + **5 lakh** sellers (15 Aug **2026**).
**NICDC** is also under **DPIIT**.
ONDC is an **open network for digital commerce**.

n7800bbb3896.s: PM-WANI, launched in 2020, seeks to provide public Wi-Fi through:
o: PDOAs under the Department of Telecommunications
n7800bbb3896.x: PM-WANI provides public Wi-Fi through Public Data Office Aggregators (PDOAs) and is associated with the Department of Telecommunications.
n7800bbb3896.tq: Match the scheme with both its delivery mechanism and nodal department.
xs: **PM-WANI (2020)** gives public Wi-Fi through **PDOAs** under **DoT** — option **(2)**.
Gram panchayat broadband is **BharatNet**, not PM-WANI.
xa: **BharatNet** began as **NOFN**.
**5G** coverage nationwide (2025-26).
**Digital India** pillars include **public internet access**.

n10b96aadf4b.x: Digital India was launched on 1 July 2015.
n10b96aadf4b.tq: Distinguish the exact launch date from other major national programme dates.
xs: **Digital India** was launched on **1 July 2015** — option **(2)**.
It is coordinated by **MeitY**.
xa: **APPSC 2025** key: Digital India-**2015**, Make in India-**2014**, Startup India-**2016**, Atmanirbhar-**2020**.
Digital India has **9 pillars**, from Broadband Highways to Early Harvest.
**MUDRA** also dates from **2015**.

n7b6d340ddf8.s: The IndiaAI Mission, approved in March 2024, has an approved outlay of about:
n7b6d340ddf8.x: IndiaAI's outlay is about Rs 10,372 crore for compute, datasets and AI innovation; fab and ATMP incentives belong to the India Semiconductor Mission.
xa: IndiaAI covers **compute, datasets and AI innovation**; a **Digital India** sub-scheme.
It is expanding **compute, data-centre capacity, HPC** (1 Jul **2026**).
India Semiconductor Mission is under **MeitY**.

n1e7ed5b8f1b.s: NICDC, functioning under DPIIT, is associated with:
o: Industrial corridors and smart industrial cities
n1e7ed5b8f1b.x: NICDC is associated with industrial corridors and smart industrial cities under DPIIT.
xa: **ONDC** is also promoted by **DPIIT**.
AP has **three industrial corridors** (VCIC with **ADB**).
AP corridor nodes: **Krishnapatnam, Orvakal, Kopparthy**.

na07b1b5f245.s: India's renewable energy capacity grew between 2015 and 2025 from approximately:
na07b1b5f245.x: Renewable capacity grew from about 40 GW in 2015 to about 260 GW in 2025.
xa: Renewables are near **50%** of installed capacity (2025-26).
**PM Surya Ghar** added **8.7 GW** (**2026**).
NGHM aims at **125 GW** RE by **2030**.

n83b9e9889b9.s: The stated objective of Talliki Vandanam is to reduce schooling costs and thereby improve the
n83b9e9889b9.x: Talliki Vandanam is intended to reduce the cost of schooling and raise the Gross Enrolment Ratio.
n83b9e9889b9.tq: Link the immediate welfare benefit with its stated educational outcome.
xs: **Talliki Vandanam** cuts schooling costs to raise the **Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER)** — option **(3)** (**APPSC 2025**).
It is an education scheme, so MMR, irrigation or labour-force indicators are not its stated target.
xa: It pays **₹15,000 per child per year** to the mother.
It replaced **Jagananna Amma Vodi** (launched **January 2020**).
AP Budget 2026-27: **Rs 8,456 crore**.
AP's **MMR (45)** and **IMR (24)** are better than national.

n87c5e165567.s: Under Auto Driver Sevalo, which succeeded YSR Vahana Mitra, the annual assistance to self-owned auto owners changed from:
n87c5e165567.x: YSR Vahana Mitra gave ₹10,000 a year to self-owned auto/taxi drivers; Auto Driver Sevalo gives ₹15,000 a year to owners of self-owned autos.
xa: Vahana Mitra covered **auto and taxi owner-drivers**.
⚠ **₹15,000** = Talliki Vandanam and Auto Driver Sevalo.
Other renames: **Rythu Bharosa → Annadata Sukhibhava**; **Spandana → PGRS**.

n74789913c93.s: Talliki Vandanam of Andhra Pradesh replaced which earlier scheme?
n74789913c93.x: Talliki Vandanam replaced Jagananna Amma Vodi, which paid ₹15,000 a year to the mother/guardian of a poor child sent to school. Vidya Deevena is fee reimbursement; Aasara repaid SHG loans.
xa: Talliki Vandanam: **₹15,000 per child per year**; Budget 2026-27 **Rs 8,456 crore**.
Aim: raise **GER** (**APPSC 2025**).
Other renames: **YSR Pension Kanuka → NTR Bharosa Pension**.

n0b939819243.s: The 16th Finance Commission found that Andhra Pradesh had the highest among States in respect of:
n0b939819243.x: The 16th Finance Commission found Andhra Pradesh to have the highest per-capita social security pension spending among States.
n0b939819243.tq: Focus on the precise comparison—per-capita pension spending—not a broader welfare indicator.
xs: The **16th Finance Commission** found AP has the **highest per-capita social security pension spending** — option **(1)**.
The notes call AP the State that spends the most per head on social pensions.
xa: CM claims NTR Bharosa is **India's largest welfare scheme**.
**₹73,506 crore** spent on pensions since June **2024**.

n1679a298df0.s: Aarogyasri (Rajiv Aarogyasri in 2007, later Dr YSR Aarogyasri) in Andhra Pradesh, is presently known as:
n1679a298df0.x: The Aarogyasri scheme, introduced in 2007 as Rajiv Aarogyasri and renamed Dr YSR Aarogyasri in 2019, is now known as Dr NTR Vaidya Seva.
n1679a298df0.tq: Test a renamed scheme through a direct predecessor-successor distinction.
xs: Aarogyasri is now called **Dr NTR Vaidya Seva** (**2024**) — option **(4)**.
Name trail: **Rajiv Aarogyasri (2007)** → **Dr NTR Vaidya Seva (2014)** → **Dr YSR Aarogyasri (2019)** → **Dr NTR Vaidya Seva (2024)**.
xa: It gives cashless care to **1.43 crore families** for **3,257 procedures**.
It is linked with **Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY**.
Other renames: **Spandana → PGRS**; **YSR Pension Kanuka → NTR Bharosa Pension**.

n9a4c3241697.s: Jagananna Chedodu provided ₹10,000 a year to which group owning shops?
o: Self-employed tailors, rajakas and nayee brahmins
n9a4c3241697.x: Jagananna Chedodu provides ₹10,000 per year to self-employed tailors, rajakas and nayee brahmins with shops.
xa: YSR Kapu Nestham: **₹15,000** a year to women aged **45-60**.
⚠ **₹10,000** a year was also **Vahana Mitra** (auto and taxi drivers).
Pregnant women and children get **Sampoorna Poshana**.

n0d6d55d587b.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the Spandana grievance portal is now referred to as:
n0d6d55d587b.x: Spandana was the grievance portal and is now referred to as PGRS.
xa: Other renames: **Village/Ward Secretariats → Swarna Gramam and Swarna Ward**.
**Jagananna Amma Vodi → Talliki Vandanam**.
**Vahana Mitra → Auto Driver Sevalo ₹15,000**.

n9714fd1828c.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the nine pillars of Navaratnalu?
n9714fd1828c.x: Navaratnalu included Jalayagnam, Pedalandariki Illu, and YSR Aasara/Cheyutha. Stree Shakti is a current Super Six guarantee, not one of the nine Navaratnalu pillars.
n9714fd1828c.tq: Find the item belonging to the current guarantee package rather than the earlier nine-pillar programme.
xs: **Stree Shakti** is not a Navaratnalu pillar — option **(1)**; it is a current **Super Six** guarantee (free bus travel for women).
**Jalayagnam**, **Pedalandariki Illu** (housing) and **YSR Aasara/Cheyutha** are Navaratnalu pillars.
xa: Other pillars: **Rythu Bharosa, fee reimbursement, Aarogyasri, prohibition, Amma Vodi, pensions, Pension Kanuka**.
Navaratnalu (YSRCP, **2019**) was funded from **revenue expenditure**.
Stree Shakti was launched on **15 Aug 2025**.

n6e02e8499ef.s: The annual benefit under Rythu Bharosa, as specified for Andhra Pradesh, is:
n6e02e8499ef.x: AP’s Rythu Bharosa provides ₹13,500 a year per family, including tenants and ROFR holders. The ₹12,000 per acre figure belongs to Telangana’s Rythu Bharosa, while ₹20,000 is associated with its replacement, Annadata Sukhibhava.
n6e02e8499ef.tq: Trap a reversed State comparison and distinguish the replacement scheme.
xs: AP's **Rythu Bharosa** gave **₹13,500 a year per family** (Centre + State) — option **(4)**.
⚠ **₹12,000 an acre** is **Telangana's** Rythu Bharosa.
**₹20,000** belongs to its successor, **Annadata Sukhibhava**.
xa: Rythu Bharosa covered farmers including **tenants and ROFR holders**.
Annadata Sukhibhava = **₹14,000 State + ₹6,000 PM-KISAN**.
**₹10,000** a year was **Vahana Mitra**.

n455f24827a8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's Stree Shakti scheme?
o: It was later extended to persons with disabilities
Free travel is available in all APSRTC bus categories without exception
Women's share of bus travel rose from 40% to 65%
n455f24827a8.x: Free travel covers 5 APSRTC bus categories, not all.
xa: Beneficiaries: **women and transgender persons** with AP domicile.
**71 crore+** free journeys by 13 Jun **2026**.
Free bus travel for women was a **G2-GS 2025** key.

n67fef14853d.s: The Matsyakara Bharosa benefit to marine fishermen during the fishing ban was raised from:
n67fef14853d.x: The benefit under Matsyakara Bharosa was raised from ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 per family.
xa: ⚠ **₹20,000** = Annadata Sukhibhava (per farmer family) and Matsyakara Bharosa (per fisher family).
⚠ **₹15,000** = Talliki Vandanam and Auto Driver Sevalo.
**Fishermen** are also an **NTR Bharosa** pension category.

ne2411dfd5d4.s: The Rs 20,000 annual benefit under Annadata Sukhibhava consists of:
o: Rs 10,000 each from the State and PM-KISAN
Rs 15,000 from the State and Rs 5,000 from PM-KISAN
Rs 14,000 from the State and Rs 6,000 from PM-KISAN
Rs 14,000 from PM-KISAN and Rs 6,000 from the State
ne2411dfd5d4.x: The benefit comprises Rs 14,000 from the State and Rs 6,000 through PM-KISAN.
ne2411dfd5d4.tq: Split a composite figure into its stated components.
xs: The **₹20,000** is **Rs 14,000 from the State + Rs 6,000 from PM-KISAN** — option **(3)**.
Option (4) reverses the two shares.
xa: Paid in **₹7,000 / ₹7,000 / ₹6,000** instalments.
Tenant farmers are included.

nf2ee6e9e807.s: Deepam-2 provides which of the following benefits?
o: Three free LPG cylinders per year to 33.32 lakh families
Three free LPG cylinders per year to 83 lakh families
Two free LPG cylinders per year to 83 lakh families
One free LPG cylinder per month to all households
nf2ee6e9e807.x: Deepam-2 provides three free LPG cylinders annually to 83 lakh families.
nf2ee6e9e807.tq: Check the combination of benefit, frequency and coverage.
xs: **Deepam-2** gives **3 free LPG cylinders a year** to **83 lakh** families — option **(2)**.
**33.32** (crore) is the count of **Stree Shakti** trips, not Deepam families.
xa: Deepam-2 launched **2024**; about **2 crore** cylinders, **₹2,684 crore** (1 Jan **2026**).
Earlier **Deepam (1999)** gave LPG connections.
Deepam is part of **Super Six**.

nf575af5679a.s: The employment-related promise under the Super Six programme consists of
nf575af5679a.x: The promise is for 20 lakh jobs or an unemployment allowance of ₹3,000.
nf575af5679a.tq: Compare the paired job target and allowance amount as one combined promise.
xs: Super Six job promise: **20 lakh jobs** or **₹3,000** unemployment allowance — option **(2)**.
Tracked via **ITI and skill placements** (2024-25).
xa: **Aadabidda Nidhi**: **₹1,500** a month to women.
**Talliki Vandanam**: **₹15,000** per child per year.
Opposition: Super Six **only partly delivered**.

n90a024af37b.s: The AP Chief Minister's approach to welfare delivery treats ____ as the basic unit.
n90a024af37b.x: The Chief Minister stated that the family should be the unit for welfare, including family mapping before sanctioning new pensions.
xa: Existing pensioners continue.
Ration: **5 kg rice for every family member**, family as the unit.
**Village/Ward Secretariats** have mapped **1.68 crore** households.

n40a8ba2100e.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the central NSAP pension amount is supplemented by:
o: The State government from its own funds
n40a8ba2100e.x: Andhra Pradesh tops up the central NSAP pension from State funds.
xa: AP's old-age pension is **₹4,000/month**.
AP has the **highest per-capita social security pension spending** (**16th FC**).
Budget 2026-27: **₹27,719 crore** for NTR Bharosa.

n406880e6da2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about minority welfare in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Pilgrimage assistance is limited to Haj only
Imams and Mouzams receive ₹5,000–10,000 per month
The annual expenditure on this assistance is ₹180 crore
Urdu is the second official language of the State
n406880e6da2.x: Pilgrimage assistance covers both Haj and Jerusalem.
xa: Minority allocation: **₹6,090 crore** (2026-27).
**Dulhan** (**April 2015**) gave **₹50,000** to Muslim brides.
Education support: post-matric scholarships, **RTF**, **Mega DSC** coaching.

n77010bc60aa.s: A meal at an Anna Canteen in Andhra Pradesh is priced at:
n77010bc60aa.x: Anna Canteens provide a meal priced at ₹5.
n77010bc60aa.tq: Recall the flagship unit price associated with the programme.
xs: An **Anna Canteen** meal costs **₹5** — option **(3)**.
The canteens serve **subsidised meals for the urban poor**.
xa: **62 rural canteens** opened on 15 Apr **2026** at **Dharanikota (Palnadu)**.
Total canteens: **269**.
⚠ **5 kg** rice per family member is the ration plan — a different "5".

n342681c6ad4.s: The target mentioned for Jal Jeevan Mission coverage in rural Andhra Pradesh is to provide tap connections to all rural households by:
n342681c6ad4.x: The stated target is coverage of all rural households by 2027.
n342681c6ad4.tq: Distinguish the future target year from the current coverage statistic.
xs: JJM aims at tap connections for **all rural households by 2027** — option **(3)**.
So far **70.04 lakh** households (**73%**) have tap connections (2024-25).
xa: **Swachh Andhra** is one of the **10 Sutralu**; **500 ODF Plus villages** milestone.
**CLAP** handles door-to-door garbage collection.
**2029** is the house-site target, a trap.

n3597b2e2a88.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about sanitation-related developments in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Swachh Andhra is one of the 10 Sutralu
A milestone of 500 ODF Plus villages was reported
The ODF Plus milestone was reported in January 2026
n3597b2e2a88.x: CLAP was launched on 2 October 2021, not on 15 August 2025.
xa: CLAP results (2024-25): segregation **96.07%**; **6,890 tonnes/day** processed.
**104 STPs** (**690.90 MLD**); **171** under construction.
JJM: **70.04 lakh** households (**73%**) with taps; all by **2027**.

n4a8ce6d6d92.s: Navaratnalu was associated with which period?
n4a8ce6d6d92.x: Navaratnalu was the nine-pillar welfare framework associated with the period 2019–2024.
n4a8ce6d6d92.tq: Discriminate between the programme period and the periods of other State initiatives.
xs: **Navaratnalu** belongs to **2019-24** — option **(3)**; it was the YSRCP government's package.
**2014-19** was the earlier **NTR Bharosa** pension era; the **present government** runs **Super Six**.
xa: Navaratnalu = **nine** flagship welfare promises, funded from **revenue expenditure**.
Cheyutha's name first belonged to a Naidu-era scheme (**1995-2004**).
CM Naidu reviewed Super Six at the **8th Collectors' Conference** (12 Sep **2026**).

nde45bd3929f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the NTR Bharosa Pension scheme?
o: It was earlier known as YSR Pension Kanuka (2019–24)
It was renamed NTR Bharosa from June 2024
The enhanced pension applies to old-age and widow beneficiaries
The monthly pension was enhanced from ₹3,000 to ₹5,000
nde45bd3929f.x: The pension was enhanced from ₹3,000 to ₹4,000 from April 2024.
xa: Overall range **₹4,000-15,000/month** to **65+ lakh** beneficiaries.

n704d9453805.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's Disha Bill, 2019?
o: The AP Cabinet approved its withdrawal after the Centre advised reconsideration
The BNS and BNSS came into force on 1 July 2023
The advice was linked to the replacement of the IPC and CrPC by the BNS and BNSS
The BNS and BNSS replaced the IPC and CrPC
n704d9453805.x: The BNS and BNSS came into force on 1 July 2024.
xa: The Bill had aimed at a **21-day** timeline (investigation **7** + trial **14** days).
Delivery arms: **Disha SOS app**, **Disha police stations**.
**Women Helpline 181** was universalised in **2019**.

n130f9aa986b.s: The minimum age prescribed for eligibility as an old-age pensioner under NTR Bharosa in Andhra Pradesh is:
n130f9aa986b.x: Old-age pension under NTR Bharosa is available to persons aged 60 years and above.
n130f9aa986b.tq: Directly recall the age threshold rather than confusing it with the widow-pension age.
xs: Old-age pension under **NTR Bharosa** starts at **60 years** and above — option **(3)**.
Widows qualify from **18 years**.
xa: Old age and widow pension is **₹4,000/month** from **April 2024**.
⚠ Exam angle: the **₹3,000 → ₹4,000** revision and the **60/18** age limits.
Bihar's **Mukhyamantri Vriddhajan Pension Yojana** is for the poor above **60** (**APPSC 2019**).

n5e1b1f11ef8.s: A widow becomes eligible for the widow pension category under NTR Bharosa from the age of:
n5e1b1f11ef8.x: The age criterion for widow pension under NTR Bharosa is 18 years and above.
n5e1b1f11ef8.tq: Separate the special category age limit from the 60-year old-age pension limit.
xs: Widows qualify for NTR Bharosa pension from **18 years** and above — option **(1)**.
**60 years** is the **old-age** limit.
xa: Widow pension: **₹4,000/month** (from ₹3,000, w.e.f. **April 2024**).
Categories also include **single women** and **transgender** persons.
**Spouse pensions** go to surviving wives (**6,268** new, Sep **2026**).

naa9ecb212d4.s: In Andhra Pradesh, persons with 40% or more disability receive a monthly pension of:
naa9ecb212d4.x: Persons with 40% or more disability receive ₹6,000 per month without an age limit; ₹10,000 is for thalassaemia and similar patients.
xa: About **65+ lakh** beneficiaries overall.

n38b9e0b131c.s: The nodal agency for NTR Bharosa pensions in Andhra Pradesh is:
n38b9e0b131c.x: SERP is the nodal agency for NTR Bharosa pensions.
xa: Pensions are delivered at the **doorstep** with **Aadhaar biometric (ABBA)** authentication.
SERP also reaches **84.47 lakh** rural women (SHGs).
⚠ **SERP** = rural women; **MEPMA** = urban SHGs.

n904a406b958.s: The automated monthly distribution of NTR Bharosa pensions uses which mechanism to remove ghost beneficiaries?
n904a406b958.x: Pension distribution is automated using Aadhaar-based biometric authentication, intended to eliminate ghost beneficiaries.
n904a406b958.tq: Identify the operational mechanism that directly addresses the stated administrative problem.
xs: Distribution is automated with **Aadhaar-based biometric authentication** (Jan **2026**) — option **(4)**.
This **removes ghost beneficiaries**.
xa: Delivery is at the **doorstep** with **ABBA**; **SERP** is nodal.
**DBT** on the **JAM trinity** also cuts ghost beneficiaries and middlemen.
Dec 2025: **63.12 lakh** pensions, **₹2,744 cr** a month.

nf8a92e4603e.s: The expenditure on NTR Bharosa pensions in Andhra Pradesh was estimated at what amount in 2026-27?
nf8a92e4603e.x: NTR Bharosa pension expenditure was estimated at ₹27,719 crore in 2026-27.
nf8a92e4603e.tq: Distinguish the welfare allocation from interest, capital outlay and revenue-deficit figures.
xs: NTR Bharosa got **₹27,719 crore** in Budget **2026-27** — option **(2)**.
It is far above the **₹4,407 crore** of Budget 2024-25 BE.
xa: **₹73,506 crore** spent on pensions since June **2024**.
⚠ **Rs 8,456 crore** = Talliki Vandanam (2026-27).

nd5992617762.s: YSR Cheyutha (2019-24) provided ₹18,750 a year to which beneficiaries?
o: Kapu, Balija, Telaga and Ontari women aged 45-60
BC, SC, ST and minority women aged 45-60
Self-employed tailors, rajakas and nayee brahmins
nd5992617762.x: YSR Cheyutha gave ₹18,750 a year to BC/SC/ST/minority women aged 45-60, linking them to livestock units and Pasu Kisan Credit Cards. Kapu, Balija, Telaga and Ontari women of the same age got ₹15,000 under YSR Kapu Nestham; tailors, rajakas and nayee brahmins got Jagananna Chedodu; mothers got Amma Vodi/Talliki Vandanam.
xs: **YSR Cheyutha (2019-24)** gave **₹18,750** a year to **BC/SC/ST/minority women** aged **45-60** — option **(2)**.
**Kapu, Balija, Telaga, Ontari** women (45-60) got **₹15,000** under **YSR Kapu Nestham**.
Tailors, rajakas, nayee brahmins = **Jagananna Chedodu**; mothers = **Amma Vodi / Talliki Vandanam**.
xa: Cheyutha beneficiaries were linked to **livestock units** and **Pasu Kisan Credit Cards**.
The name Cheyutha first belonged to a **1998** TDP scheme for **handicapped persons**.

nf832ad4773c.s: Direct Benefit Transfer through the JAM trinity mainly helps to reduce:
nf832ad4773c.x: DBT through the JAM trinity helps reduce ghost beneficiaries and middlemen in welfare delivery.
xa: Pensions use **Aadhaar biometric (ABBA)** authentication at the doorstep.
Criticism: **"new welfarism"** favours DBT and tangible transfers over public goods.
Kerala is moving pensions from doorstep delivery to **DBT**.

n306604f8e99.s: Aarogyasri was initially introduced in Andhra Pradesh in 2007 under the leadership of:
n306604f8e99.x: Aarogyasri began in 2007 under Y. S. Rajasekhara Reddy.
n306604f8e99.tq: Match the scheme’s launch year with the person associated with its introduction.
xs: **Aarogyasri** began in **2007** under **YSR — Y. S. Rajasekhara Reddy** — option **(3)**.
Name trail: **Rajiv Aarogyasri (2007)** → **Dr NTR Vaidya Seva (2014)** → **Dr YSR Aarogyasri (2019)** → **Dr NTR Vaidya Seva (2024)**.
xa: Coverage: cashless care to **1.43 crore families**, **3,257 procedures**; linked with **PM-JAY**.
**108** and Aarogyasri are YSR-era schemes.
**EHS** covers State government employees and pensioners through the same Trust.

n0e27f7437ee.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the health insurance model announced in Andhra Pradesh in May 2025?
o: It was meant only for families below the poverty line
It proposed coverage up to ₹25 lakh per family per year
It was intended for about 1.65 crore families
It was announced by Health Minister Y. Satya Kumar Yadav
n0e27f7437ee.x: The model was intended for poor and middle-class families, not only BPL families.
xa: ⚠ **G2-GS 2024** keyed "covers up to ₹25 lakh per family a year" as correct.
⚠ **Universal Health Policy**: **₹2.5 lakh** for every citizen; **₹25 lakh** for poor families.
Health budget 2026-27: **₹19,305 crore**.

n6c6b331bef4.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the 104 service provides:
o: Mobile medical units with fixed-day village health services
n6c6b331bef4.x: 104 operates mobile medical units with fixed-day village health services, whereas 108 is the emergency ambulance service.
xa: 108 runs **768 ambulances** and has transported **9.22 lakh patients**.
**108 and Aarogyasri** are YSR-era schemes.
**EHS** gives cashless treatment to State employees and pensioners via the **NTR Vaidya Seva Trust**.

n0e7f851a4e2.s: Under AP's Universal Health Policy, poor persons receive treatment up to ____ through the NTR Vaidya Seva Trust.
n0e7f851a4e2.x: Every citizen gets free treatment up to ₹2.5 lakh, while poor persons get treatment up to ₹25 lakh through the NTR Vaidya Seva Trust.
xa: ⚠ **₹2.5 lakh** = every citizen (insurance mode); **₹25 lakh** = poor families.
May **2025** model: up to **₹25 lakh** per family for about **1.65 crore** families.
**EHS** covers State government employees through the same Trust.

n7720308936b.s: The stated proposal for ration rice distribution in Andhra Pradesh is:
o: 5 kg per family, irrespective of size
5 kg per family member, treating the family as the unit
10 kg per family, irrespective of size
n7720308936b.x: The proposal is 5 kg of rice for every family member, with the family treated as the unit.
xa: Rice subsidy: **₹2,345 crore** in 2024-25 BE.
**Mee Mart** (Jul **2026**): PDS modernised with **NCCF**.
Family mapping is also required before new pensions.

n28e3b565b9a.s: Giri Gorumudda provides nutrition support to:
o: Tribal mothers and young children in Agency areas
n28e3b565b9a.x: Giri Gorumudda provides nutrition support to tribal mothers and young children in Agency areas.
xa: Tribal take-home package is richer: **egg + 200 ml milk**.
**YSR Sampoorna Poshana Plus** runs in tribal mandals.
