⚠ **Prakasam** also has a proposed **NIMZ** and the **REMZ** BHAVYA park.

nd40d0430718.s: National Investment and Manufacturing Zones (NIMZs) in Andhra Pradesh have been proposed in which districts?
nd40d0430718.x: NIMZs are proposed in Chittoor and Prakasam. Kurnool hosts the Orvakal HBIC node, and Krishna, Guntur, Srikakulam and Vizianagaram are not named for NIMZs.
xs: **NIMZs** are proposed in **Chittoor and Prakasam** — option **(2)** is correct.
**Kurnool** hosts the **Orvakal** HBIC node; Krishna has the **Mallavalli** Mega Food Park.
xa: **Chittoor** is also a **VCIC** node (Srikalahasti-Yerpedu, Naidupeta).
**Prakasam** has the long-term VCIC node **Donakonda** and the **REMZ**.
Prakasam's industry focus: **mineral-based**.

na91954b9220.s: Which is the correct set of VCIC nodes in Andhra Pradesh?
na91954b9220.x: VCIC's AP nodes are Visakhapatnam, Chittoor (Srikalahasti-Yerpedu) and Kopparthy; Krishnapatnam is a CBIC node and Orvakal an HBIC node.
xa: VCIC: **3 nodes**, **33,000 acres** (**30%** start-up area); **₹3,300 crore** ADB loan in two tranches.
Chittoor node also covers **Naidupeta**; Vizag node covers **Rambilli, Nakkapalli**.
Long-term VCIC nodes: **Donakonda** (Prakasam) + **Machilipatnam**.

n6a8bffa3bbe.s: The Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor is described as India's first:
n6a8bffa3bbe.x: VCIC (about 800 km) is described as India's first coastal corridor and is the first phase of the East Coast Economic Corridor. Its ADB programme totals US$840 million, of which ADB gives US$625 million and the AP government US$215 million.
n6a8bffa3bbe.tq: Use the distinctive descriptive label rather than confusing the corridor with its financing figure.
xs: VCIC is India's **first coastal corridor** — option **(1)** is correct.
It runs about **800 km** and is the **first phase** of the **East Coast Economic Corridor** (Kolkata-Kanyakumari).
xa: It ties to **Act East** + **Make in India**, linking India to **ASEAN and East Asia**.
ADB programme: **US$ 840 mn** (ADB **625**, GoAP **215**).
VCIC AP nodes: **Vizag, Chittoor, Kopparthy**; long-term nodes **Donakonda** and **Machilipatnam**.

n5d8e6cdb395.s: The international orientation of the Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor is associated with linking India to
o: North America through the Pacific trade route
ASEAN and East Asia under the Act East framework
Europe and Central Asia through the North-South corridor
Africa and West Asia through the Suez route
n5d8e6cdb395.x: VCIC is linked with the Act East policy and Make in India and is intended to connect India with ASEAN and East Asia.
n5d8e6cdb395.tq: Identify the policy-region combination associated with the corridor.
xs: VCIC links India to **ASEAN and East Asia** under **Act East** — option **(2)** is correct.
It also ties to **Make in India**.
xa: VCIC: ~**800 km**; first phase of the **East Coast Economic Corridor**.
North part: **metallurgy, pharma, petrochemicals, IT**; south part: **food processing, leather, auto**.
India's **first coastal corridor**.

n2af88d84e1d.s: Who is the executing agency for the VCIC programme?
o: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
n2af88d84e1d.x: The Department of Industries and Commerce is the executing agency for VCIC. A Project Management Unit functions under the Commissioner of Industries.
n2af88d84e1d.tq: Apply the 'who would do this job?' approach to identify the implementing authority.
xs: The **Department of Industries and Commerce** (DOIC) is the VCIC executing agency — option **(1)** is correct.
A **PMU** functions under the **Commissioner of Industries**.
xa: ADB projects in AP: **VCIC, power, urban water**.
ADB programme total: **US$ 840 mn**.
VCIC power transmission (started **2018**): **₹694.90 crore** sanction for **2** Tranche-I packages.

nb662b2a3847.s: The Kia India plant in Andhra Pradesh is located at:
nb662b2a3847.x: Kia is at Penukonda (Sri Sathya Sai district); Isuzu is at Sri City, JSW Steel in YSR Kadapa and gas-based fertiliser at Kakinada.
xa: JSW plant: Phase-I **₹4,500 cr**; total **₹16,350 cr**.
**Royal Enfield** is being set up **near Tirupati**; **Hero MotoCorp** is at Sri City.
Steel cluster: **JSW** (Kadapa), **AM/NS** (Anakapalli), **RINL** (Vizag).

n8dd89735644.s: The Bulk Drug Park of Andhra Pradesh, spread over about 2,002 acres, is located at:
n8dd89735644.x: The Bulk Drug Park is at Nakkapalli (2,002 acres), which along with Parawada (JN Pharma City) forms the pharma cluster. Orvakal is the HBIC node, Kopparthy the VCIC node in YSR Kadapa, and Penukonda hosts the Kia plant.
xs: The **Bulk Drug Park** (**2,002 acres**) is at **Nakkapalli** — option **(2)** is correct.
**Orvakal** (Kurnool) is the **HBIC** node; **Kopparthy** (YSR Kadapa) is a **VCIC** node; **Penukonda** hosts the **Kia** plant.
xa: Pharma cluster: **Parawada (JN Pharma City)** + **Bulk Drug Park, Nakkapalli**.
The new **AM/NS India** steel plant is also at **Rajayyapeta, Nakkapalli (Anakapalli)**.
Vizag VCIC node focus: **bulk drug and steel** (Rambilli, Nakkapalli - Anakapalli).

n3caa54fd004.s: The Eastern Naval Command is headquartered at:
n3caa54fd004.x: Visakhapatnam is the Eastern Naval Command headquarters and also has a Naval Dockyard.
xa: Other Vizag units: **Hindustan Shipyard** (**1941**, India's oldest), **BHPV** (**1966**), **HPCL refinery** (**13.7 MMTPA**).
**RINL** steel plant: **7.3 MTPA**.
The **CII Partnership Summit** was held at **Visakhapatnam**, **14-15 Nov 2025**.

n5f19008331f.s: The new AM/NS India steel plant in Andhra Pradesh is proposed at:
n5f19008331f.x: The AM/NS India steel plant is being established at Rajayyapeta near Nakkapalli in Anakapalli district.
n5f19008331f.tq: Test the exact industrial location rather than the broader coastal-region association.
xs: The new **AM/NS India** plant is at **Rajayyapeta, Nakkapalli, Anakapalli district** — option **(2)** is correct.
**Orvakal** (Kurnool) is the HBIC node and **Kopparthy** (YSR Kadapa) a VCIC node.
xa: AM/NS data: **₹1.36 lakh crore**; **17.8 MTPA** in two phases (Phase-I **7.3 MTPA** by Dec **2028**).
Foundation laid **23 Mar 2026**.
Nakkapalli also hosts the **Bulk Drug Park** (**2,002 acres**).

nc9abdd4377d.s: Sri City is associated with which combination of facilities or zones?
o: SEZ, export processing zone and petroleum reserve only
CBIC node, HBIC node, DTZ and dry port only
SEZ, PCPIR, greenfield port and MTPA terminal
nc9abdd4377d.x: Sri City comprises an SEZ, Domestic Tariff Zone, Free Trade and Warehousing Zone and Electronics Manufacturing Cluster. A dry-port proposal was under examination.
nc9abdd4377d.tq: Recall the complete facility combination rather than one isolated designation.
xs: **Sri City** combines an **SEZ, DTZ, FTWZ and EMC** — option **(1)** is correct.
It is not a PCPIR, CBIC/HBIC node or greenfield port; a **dry-port proposal** is only **under examination**.
xa: Sri City is in **Tirupati** district.
Units there: **Isuzu**, auto components, electronics (EMC), **Kobelco**, **Foxconn**.
**Hero MotoCorp** (two-wheelers) is also at Sri City.

n11aa1b16d27.s: Andhra Pradesh MedTech Zone (AMTZ), located at Visakhapatnam, is primarily associated with which sector?
n11aa1b16d27.x: AMTZ at Visakhapatnam is a dedicated medical devices park.
xs: **AMTZ** at **Visakhapatnam** is a **medical devices** park — option **(4)** is correct.
Petrochemicals belong to the **Kakinada-Vizag PCPIR**; cement to the **Kadapa-Kurnool belt**.
xa: ⚠ **AMTZ** = Visakhapatnam; **Drone City** = Kurnool; **Space City** = Tirupati.
Vizag node: **bulk drugs, steel**; **Parawada Pharma City**.
Vizag hosted the **CII Partnership Summit** (**14-15 Nov 2025**).

nbc868626e73.s: KRIS City, associated with the Krishnapatnam Industrial Area, is located in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
nbc868626e73.x: KRIS City is located in the Tirupati district, next to Krishnapatnam Port.
xs: **KRIS City** is in **Tirupati** district, next to **Krishnapatnam port** — option **(3)** is correct.
PYQ G2 **2023** matched **KRIS City → Tirupati district, CBIC**.
xa: ⚠ Survey 2025-26 lists the Krishnapatnam node under **SPSR Nellore**.
KRIS City focus: **auto, aerospace, apparel, textiles, ESDM**, **heavy industries**.
Krishnapatnam North: **10,834.5 acres**; **₹2,139 crore**.

nd96180f70af.s: Sri City in Andhra Pradesh is associated with which combination of industries and enterprises?
o: Isuzu, Kobelco, Foxconn and automobile components
JSW Steel, Dalmia Bharat and Zuari Cement
Kia India, Royal Enfield and bulk drugs
nd96180f70af.x: Sri City, in Tirupati district, hosts Isuzu, Kobelco, Foxconn and automobile-component industries.
nd96180f70af.tq: Start from the sure enterprise-location association.
xs: Sri City hosts **Isuzu, Kobelco, Foxconn and automobile components** — option **(1)** is correct.
**JSW, Dalmia, Zuari** are Kadapa-Kurnool units; **HPCL, RINL** are in Vizag; **Kia** is at Penukonda.
xa: Sri City (Tirupati): **SEZ + DTZ + FTWZ + EMC**.
A **dry-port proposal** is under examination (28 Jul 2026).
**Hero MotoCorp** (two-wheelers) is also at Sri City.

n7825bbcfda7.s: The earliest industrial units of Rayalaseema were primarily associated with
o: Cotton ginning, textiles and mineral-based mills
n7825bbcfda7.x: The earliest Rayalaseema industrial units comprised cotton ginning, textile and mineral-based mills; large-scale investments expanded mainly during the last 15 years.
n7825bbcfda7.tq: Recall the historical industrial base rather than recent investments.
xs: Rayalaseema's earliest industrial units were **cotton ginning, textile and mineral-based mills** — so option **(4)** is correct.
**Mega investments** came to Rayalaseema only in the **last 15 years**; petrochemicals, autos and aerospace are recent or coastal sectors.
Petrochemicals belong to the **Kakinada-Vizag** belt (KG-basin gas), not early Rayalaseema.
xa: Rayalaseema's modern anchors: **Kia India** (Penukonda), **Royal Enfield** (near Tirupati), **JSW steel** (Kadapa), solar parks.
**Dalmia Bharat** and **Zuari** cement are limestone-based units in the **Kadapa-Kurnool belt**.
Six **BHAVYA** parks were submitted to **DPIIT** (24 Aug 2026), several in Rayalaseema.

nb76040a3c59.s: The HPCL refinery at Visakhapatnam was set up in 1957 by:
nb76040a3c59.x: Caltex set up the refinery in 1957; Kobelco is a Sri City company.
xa: HPCL Visakh Refinery capacity: **13.7 MMTPA**.
RINL's main ore source is **Bailadila** (Chhattisgarh); capacity **7.3 MTPA** since **2017-18**.
⚠ **APGIC** = APIIC-APGENCO JV on KG gas; **APGDC** = gas grids + **FSRU-based LNG terminal** at Kakinada.

nf82ef96f0f1.s: RINL-Visakhapatnam Steel Plant is distinguished as India's first:
nf82ef96f0f1.x: The RINL-Visakhapatnam Steel Plant is India's first shore-based integrated steel plant.
nf82ef96f0f1.tq: Use the distinctive location-based description to identify the correct industrial unit.
xs: RINL-Visakhapatnam Steel Plant is India's **first shore-based integrated steel plant** (**1992**) — option **(2)** is correct.
It is coastal, not inland, and was built with **USSR** technology (agreement **1979**).
xa: Capacity: **7.3 MTPA** since **2017-18** (**6.3 MTPA** earlier).
Losses since **2015-16**; **₹11,440 crore** revival package approved by the Union Cabinet on **16 Jan 2025**.
Main ore source: **Bailadila** (Chhattisgarh).
⚠ **7.3 MTPA** is also the **AM/NS Phase-I** target (by Dec **2028**).

n82a22dd0a2b.s: The principal source of iron ore for the RINL-Visakhapatnam Steel Plant is:
n82a22dd0a2b.x: RINL-Visakhapatnam gets its iron ore mainly from Bailadila in Chhattisgarh.
xa: Capacity: **7.3 MTPA** since **2017-18**.
Second-phase aid of **₹8,097 crore** proposed (3 May 2026); State says **no privatisation**.
A blast killed **8 workers** at the plant (10 Jun 2026).

n5070f8e3014.s: On 16 January 2025 the Union Cabinet approved a revival package for RINL-Visakhapatnam Steel Plant of:
n5070f8e3014.x: The package was ₹11,440 crore; the plant has made losses since 2015-16 and the State says it will not be privatised.
xa: A **second-phase aid of ₹8,097 crore** was proposed (3 May 2026).
Capacity **7.3 MTPA** since **2017-18**; ore from **Bailadila**.
A blast killed **8 workers** (10 Jun 2026).

n3543c8e8b06.s: Hindustan Shipyard, India's oldest shipyard, was established by Scindia in:
n3543c8e8b06.x: Hindustan Shipyard was established by Scindia in 1941; BHPV was set up in 1966.
xa: **HPCL Visakh Refinery**: **13.7 MMTPA**; set up by **Caltex** (**1957**).
Vizag also has the **Naval Dockyard** and **Eastern Naval Command HQ**.
RINL: first **shore-based integrated** steel plant (**1992**).

n9db91fbc095.s: Etikoppaka in Anakapalli district is known for:
n9db91fbc095.x: Etikoppaka makes lacquered wooden toys; Chirala is handloom sarees, Markapur slate and Mangalagiri cotton sarees and fabric.
xa: ⚠ **Etikoppaka** = lacquered toys (Anakapalli); **Kondapalli** = **tella poniki** toys (NTR).
**GI tags**: Dharmavaram, Mangalagiri, Kondapalli, Etikoppaka products.
**Dharmavaram** (Sri Sathya Sai) - silk sarees; **Peddapuram** (Kakinada) - silk.

nb0d0ff6e186.s: Kondapalli, situated in NTR district, is associated with which traditional product?
nb0d0ff6e186.x: Kondapalli of NTR district is famous for wooden toys made from tella poniki wood.
nb0d0ff6e186.tq: Direct recall with a confusable wooden-toy town as the trap.
xs: **Kondapalli** (NTR) is known for **wooden tella poniki toys** — option **(1)** is correct.
**Lacquered wooden toys** are from **Etikoppaka** (Anakapalli); **cotton sarees** - **Mangalagiri**; **silk sarees** - **Dharmavaram**.
xa: Kondapalli products carry a **GI tag**.
⚠ Do not confuse **Kondapalli** (NTR) with **Etikoppaka** (Anakapalli).
**Jawaharlal Nehru Auto Nagar** is in **Vijayawada, NTR**.

nf3cf61565c8.s: Which of the following towns has NOT been identified with products carrying Geographical Indication tags?
nf3cf61565c8.x: Dharmavaram, Mangalagiri, Kondapalli and Etikoppaka products carry GI tags. Chirala is not included in that stated group.
nf3cf61565c8.tq: Find the omitted town from a specified GI-tag group.
xs: **Chirala** is not in the GI-tag list — option **(2)** is correct.
The notes list **GI tags** for **Dharmavaram, Mangalagiri, Kondapalli** and **Etikoppaka** products.
xa: **Chirala** (Bapatla) is known for **handloom sarees**.
**Mangalagiri** (Guntur) - cotton sarees and fabric; **Kondapalli** (NTR) - tella poniki toys.
**Etikoppaka** (Anakapalli) - lacquered wooden toys.

nca1457f1c84.s: Which organisation is building gas grids and an FSRU-based LNG terminal at Kakinada?
nca1457f1c84.x: APGDC is building the gas grids and the FSRU-based LNG terminal; APGIC (APIIC–APGENCO JV) targets KG-basin gas.
xa: ⚠ Trap pair: **APGIC** = KG gas JV; **APGDC** = gas grids + LNG terminal.
**Kakinada-East Godavari** and **Vizag** form the fertiliser/petrochemicals cluster using **KG-basin gas**.
**East Godavari** district focus: **chemicals, petrochemicals** (Survey 2025-26).

n010c7deeb18.s: APIIC develops industrial land and parks on which model?
n010c7deeb18.x: APIIC uses the PPP model and earlier managed about 571 parks; the Survey 2025-26 counts 635 clusters.
xa: Survey 2025-26: **635 clusters** (**331** parks, **304** estates) on ~**1.21 lakh acres**.

nbbaa0e7d734.s: After 1991, the role of APIIC shifted from:
nbbaa0e7d734.x: After 1991, APIIC moved away from direct manufacturing and took on a facilitative role.
xa: APIIC est. **1973**; nodal agency for industrial land and parks; **PPP** model.
Land bank: **41,998 acres**.
AP (through APIIC) is developing **three corridors** under the **National Industrial Corridor Development Programme**.

n1bed809c113.s: Which private ports, developed through PPP, helped pull heavy industry to the Andhra Pradesh coast?
n1bed809c113.x: The private ports of Krishnapatnam and Gangavaram, developed through public–private partnership, attracted heavy industry to the coast.
xa: Criticism: **LPG-era** gains concentrated on the **coast**; policy now steers clusters to **Rayalaseema** + North Coastal Andhra.
**Krishnapatnam North** node (KRIS City) is a **CBIC** node.
**Kakinada SEZ** greenfield port: **16 MTPA**, **₹2,123 crore**.

n15022bb567c.s: Which one of the following is NOT one of the four PCPIRs identified along with Visakhapatnam-Kakinada?
n15022bb567c.x: The four PCPIRs are Visakhapatnam-Kakinada, Dahej, Paradip and Cuddalore-Nagapattinam. Kopparthy is not included in this list.
n15022bb567c.tq: Find the odd location by checking the complete named list.
xs: **Kopparthy** is not a PCPIR — option **(3)** is correct; it is a **VCIC** node in **YSR Kadapa**.
The four PCPIRs: **Visakhapatnam-Kakinada, Dahej, Paradip, Cuddalore-Nagapattinam**.
xa: Vizag-Kakinada PCPIR: approved **2009**, about **640 sq km**.
**PCPIR Policy 2020-35**: minimum area **50 sq km**; up to **20% VGF**.
Kopparthy (**₹1,264 crore**) + Orvakal were approved by **CCEA** on **28 Aug 2024**.

nd876ca41bab.s: APSEZ at Atchutapuram-Rambilli (about 3,213 acres, part of the PCPIR) was notified in:
nd876ca41bab.x: APSEZ in Anakapalli district was notified on 12 April 2007, covers about 3,213 acres and is part of the PCPIR.
xa: APSEZ is a multi-product SEZ at **Atchutapuram-Rambilli, Anakapalli**.
PCPIR partner: **Kakinada SEZ** (petrochemicals).
**VSEZ Development Authority** oversees AP, Telangana, Chhattisgarh, Yanam.

nbc669aca597.s: The Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation (APIIC), the nodal agency for industrial land and parks, was established in:
nbc669aca597.x: APIIC was set up in 1973. 1956 is the year of the old State's formation, 1991 marks the shift after which APIIC became a facilitator, and 2007 is when APSEZ was notified.
xs: APIIC was established in **1973** — option **(2)** is correct.
**1991** marks APIIC's shift to **facilitator**; **2007** is when **APSEZ** was notified.
xa: APIIC works on a **PPP** model; nodal agency for industrial land and parks.
It has **635 clusters** and a land bank of **41,998 acres**.
APIIC developed **10** of AP's **47+** SEZs.

n16b658ec44f.s: The $715 million Project Loan of the VCIC project is shared between ADB and the Government of AP in the ratio:
n16b658ec44f.x: The Project Loan is 70:30 ADB–GoAP; the $125 million Policy-Based Loan is fully ADB-financed.
xa: Policy-based loan funds **EoDB**, corridor institutions, skills; project loan funds **roads, power, water, park infrastructure**.
Tranche-II **May 2023** (**US$ 141.12 mn**).
Executing agency: **Department of Industries and Commerce**.

n4a963634f61.s: Which policy currently governs large, mega and ultra-mega industries in Andhra Pradesh for the period 2024–29?
n4a963634f61.x: AP Industrial Development Policy 4.0 governs large, mega and ultra-mega industries for 2024–29, replacing the earlier 2023–27 policy framework.
n4a963634f61.tq: Policy-name and period discrimination among successive policies.
xs: **AP Industrial Development Policy 4.0 (2024-29)** governs large, mega and ultra-mega industry — option **(1)** is correct.
The **2023-27** policy was the earlier one it replaced.
xa: Notified **26 Oct 2024**: Industrial Policy **G.O. 68**; MSME **G.O. 69**.
Guidelines: **G.O. 28** of **25 Feb 2025**.
⚠ G.O. **68** = Industrial Development Policy; G.O. **69** = MSME.

nee3b43a6716.s: Which of the following is NOT listed as a companion policy to AP Industrial Development Policy 4.0?
nee3b43a6716.x: Food Processing, Private Industrial Parks, and Aerospace and Defence are listed as companion policies. National Highway Expansion Policy is not listed among them.
nee3b43a6716.tq: Odd-one-out identification from a policy cluster.
xs: **National Highway Expansion Policy** is not a companion policy — option **(1)** is correct.
Companion 4.0 policies include **Food Processing**, **Private Industrial Parks**, **Aerospace & Defence (2025-30)**.
xa: Others: **MSME & Entrepreneur Development**, **Textile, Apparel & Garments**, **Sustainable Electric Mobility**.
Also **Space (2025-30)**, **Circular Economy**, **Leather & Footwear**.
Main policy notified **26 Oct 2024** (G.O. **68**).

na2c9a15fa9c.s: What are the stated targets for electronics production and employment in Andhra Pradesh by 2029?
na2c9a15fa9c.x: The electronics goal is production worth US$50 billion and creation of 5 lakh jobs by 2029.
na2c9a15fa9c.tq: Target-figure recall with proportionally scaled distractors.
xs: The electronics goal is **US$50 billion** production and **5 lakh jobs** by **2029** — option **(2)** is correct.
It sits in the targets of **AP Industrial Development Policy 4.0 (2024-29)**.
xa: Policy 4.0 targets: **₹30 lakh crore** investment; **5 lakh** manufacturing jobs.
Exports US$ **20 bn → 40 bn**; **175+** parks.
Manufacturing GVA ₹**3.4 → 7.3** lakh crore.

n524342a3268.s: Which of the following correctly represents the FCI-based classification of a Mega industry, excluding land cost?
n524342a3268.x: A Mega industry has FCI of ₹1,001–5,000 crore, excluding land. Sub-Large is ₹125–500 crore, Large is ₹501–1,000 crore and Ultra Mega is above ₹5,000 crore.
n524342a3268.tq: Range comparison; identify the category from its exact investment band.
xs: A **Mega** industry has FCI of **₹1,001-5,000 crore** (land excluded) — option **(1)** is correct.
**₹125-500 cr** is **Sub-Large**; **₹501-1,000 cr** is **Large**; **above ₹5,000 cr** is **Ultra Mega**.
xa: Capital subsidy: **12%** of FCI (Sub-Large/Large); up to **15%** Mega/Ultra Mega.
**+5%** for women/SC/ST/BC.
Employment Creation Subsidy: up to **10% of FCI**.

n938ce315cb8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about incentives under AP Industrial Development Policy 4.0?
o: Employment Creation Subsidy is up to 10 per cent of FCI
Net SGST is reimbursed at 100 per cent for ten years
Capital subsidy is 12 per cent of FCI for Sub-Large/Large units
Capital subsidy is up to 15 per cent for Mega/Ultra Mega units, with 5 per cent extra for women, SC, ST and BC entrepreneurs
n938ce315cb8.x: Net SGST reimbursement is 100 per cent for five years, not ten.
xa: Power cost: **₹1/unit for 2 years**; decarbonisation subsidy up to **6% of FCI**.
Categories by FCI: **Sub-Large ₹125-500 cr**; Large ₹501-1,000 cr; Mega ₹1,001-5,000 cr; Ultra Mega >₹5,000 cr.
Policy 4.0 notified **26 Oct 2024** — ⚠ G.O. **68** = Industrial Development Policy; G.O. **69** = MSME.
MSME Policy 4.0 goal: **"One Family, One Entrepreneur" by 2030**.

nf80ad89a171.s: Under MSME Policy 4.0, the objective titled “One Family, One Entrepreneur” is to be achieved by:
nf80ad89a171.x: The “One Family, One Entrepreneur” objective is targeted for achievement by 2030.
xs: **"One Family, One Entrepreneur"** is targeted by **2030** — option **(3)** is correct.
It is the slogan of **MSME Policy 4.0** (G.O. **69**).
xa: MSME capital subsidy **25%** (caps **₹25 lakh / ₹1.5 cr / ₹7 cr**); **45%** for special categories.
Apr-Dec **2025**: **1,16,776** MSMEs set up; **4.55 lakh** jobs.

n4c187391f94.s: Under Andhra Pradesh's MSME Policy 4.0, the capital subsidy for general and special-category entrepreneurs respectively is:
n4c187391f94.x: MSME Policy 4.0 gives a 25% capital subsidy (caps ₹25 lakh / ₹1.5 crore / ₹7 crore), rising to 45% for special categories. 12% and 15% are the large/mega capital subsidy rates under the Industrial Development Policy 4.0; the other pairs are not stated.
xs: MSME Policy 4.0 capital subsidy is **25%** general and **45%** special categories — option **(3)** is correct.
**12%** and **15%** are the large/mega rates under the **Industrial Development Policy 4.0**.
xa: Caps: **₹25 lakh / ₹1.5 cr / ₹7 cr**.
Goal: **"One Family, One Entrepreneur" by 2030**.
AP Cluster Development Programme: **G.O. 17**, **45 MSME clusters/CFCs**, up to **80%** aid.

nf3f9ae2898b.s: Which one of the following is NOT a function of the policy-based loan under VCIC?
o: Constructing roads, power systems and water infrastructure
nf3f9ae2898b.x: Roads, power, water and park infrastructure are financed through the project loan. The policy-based loan supports reforms, institutions and skills.
nf3f9ae2898b.tq: Separate institutional-policy expenditure from physical infrastructure expenditure.
xs: **Constructing roads, power and water infrastructure** is NOT a policy-based loan function — option **(3)**; it is the **project loan**'s job.

nd1d9c276a76.s: The completed 125-km PPP road in Andhra Pradesh linking NH-65 and NH-16 is:

**Nadikudi-Srikalahasti** is **308 km**.

o: Only a joint venture of the Centre and a State
The Centre, a State or any person, jointly or severally
nd5e4a7cd98d.x: An SEZ may be established by the Centre, a State or any person, jointly or severally; it is not restricted to government joint ventures.
xa: SEZs may be for **goods, services** or a **Free Trade Warehousing Zone**.
Proposals go via the State to the **Board of Approval**.
**APIIC** runs **10** SEZs in AP.

n618bedf2816.s: Which of the following correctly describes the trade and tariff treatment of an SEZ?
o: It is treated as foreign territory only for income-tax purposes.
It is treated as domestic territory for all trade and tariff purposes.
It has no special customs or tariff treatment.
It is treated as foreign territory for trade and tariff purposes and follows a single-window system.
n618bedf2816.x: An SEZ is treated as foreign territory for trade and tariffs and operates through a single-window system.
n618bedf2816.tq: Test the precise legal treatment by separating trade-and-tariff status from other forms of taxation.
xs: An SEZ is treated as **foreign territory for trade and tariff purposes**, with a **single-window system** — so option **(4)** is correct.
It is not domestic territory, and its foreign status is for trade and tariffs, not just income tax.
xa: Tax holidays were phased out **2017-2020**.
Since **Apr 2026**, SEZ units may sell in India at **concessional duty** (Budget 2026-27).
**Baba Kalyani Committee (2018)**: rename SEZs "**3Es**".

n48d7001d673.s: Sri City, a multi-product zone with SEZ, DTZ, FTWZ and Electronics Manufacturing Cluster components, is in which district?
n48d7001d673.x: Sri City is in Tirupati district and combines a multi-product SEZ, DTZ, Free Trade Warehousing Zone and Electronics Manufacturing Cluster.
xa: Sri City units include **Foxconn** and **Isuzu**.
A **dry port at Sri City** is under **Inter-Ministerial Committee** review.
**Brandix India Apparel City** is at **Atchutapuram**.

n5e341466391.s: The proposal for a dry port at Sri City, in Tirupati district, is under review by the:
n5e341466391.x: The Sri City dry port proposal in Tirupati district is under review by an Inter-Ministerial Committee.
n5e341466391.tq: Match the project with the authority currently examining it; do not confuse it with the SEZ approval body.
xs: The **Sri City dry port** proposal is under review by an **Inter-Ministerial Committee** — so option **(3)** is correct.
It is meant for **on-site customs clearance**.
The **Baba Kalyani Committee** dealt with SEZ reform; the **Board of Approval** clears SEZ proposals.
xa: **CBIC norm**: no new dry port within **200 km of a seaport** or **100 km of an ICD**.
AP is a "**Blue-zone**" state — relaxation only for trade hubs lacking logistics.
**VCIC** is India's **first coastal industrial corridor**.

nfc76470bd52.s: Under CBIC guidelines, a new dry port is generally not allowed within ____ of a seaport.
nfc76470bd52.x: New dry ports are generally not allowed within 200 km of a seaport (or within 100 km of an ICD).
xa: AP is a "**Blue-zone**" state → relaxation only for trade hubs lacking logistics.
A **Sri City dry port** (Tirupati dist.) is under **Inter-Ministerial Committee** review for **on-site customs clearance**.
AP's ports: **Visakhapatnam** (major) + non-major **Krishnapatnam** and **Kakinada**.

nc43ec917f5c.s: After bifurcation, Andhra Pradesh turned to port-led development mainly because it:
o: lost its major ports to Telangana
was barred by the SEZ Act from inland industry
nc43ec917f5c.x: After bifurcation, Andhra Pradesh lost Hyderabad's industrial clusters and responded by pursuing port-led development.
xa: AP's coastline is **1,053.7 km** (AP Maritime Policy 2024-29 aims to make AP India's leading **maritime gateway**).
The strategy rests on the **VCIC** — **India's first coastal industrial corridor**.
Shipbuilding: SPV **NSHIP-AP Ltd** is building the **Dugarajapatnam** cluster → **25%** of national capacity by **2047**.

nb019493ec6a.s: The Baba Kalyani Committee (2018) proposed that Special Economic Zones should be renamed as:
nb019493ec6a.x: The Baba Kalyani Committee proposed the term “3Es”, meaning Employment and Economic Enclaves, for SEZs.
nb019493ec6a.tq: Test the exact expansion of a similarly worded proposed terminology.
xs: The **Baba Kalyani Committee (2018)** proposed renaming SEZs "**3Es**" — **Employment and Economic Enclaves** — so option **(2)** is correct.
The two Es stress **employment** and **economic** activity rather than exports alone.
xa: SEZ objectives include **employment** and **additional economic activity**.
SEZ tax holidays were phased out **2017-2020**.
**Section 18** of the SEZ Act: **one IFSC per SEZ**.

ndec00f0cb38.s: As of July 2023, how many notified SEZs did Andhra Pradesh have?

xa: **Visakhapatnam** is AP's **major port**; **Krishnapatnam** and **Kakinada** are non-major ports.

AP Maritime Policy 2024(-29) uses a **1,053.7 km** coastline to make AP India's leading **maritime gateway**.

n7b6606dccdb.s: What percentage of urban workers in India are engaged in services?
n7b6606dccdb.x: Services employ 62% of India’s urban workers.

xs: **62%** of India's urban workers are in services — option **(2)** is correct.

nf95420d8f13.s: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) was launched on:

n112e1dbacc5.s: India's rank among the world's services exporters is
n112e1dbacc5.x: India is the 7th largest services exporter, with a 4.3% share of world services exports in 2024 (up from 2% in 2005). 4th, 5th and 10th are not the ranks given.
xs: India is the **7th largest services exporter** — option **(3)** is correct.

xa: ⚠ Don't confuse with tourism: India is the **8th largest tourism economy** (US$ **231.6 bn**).
Services = **largest recipient of FDI** and **more than half of GVA**.
Services exports growth: **15.3% in FY26**.

nee0e8dc22bd.s: Google's proposed AI data centre at Visakhapatnam and Anakapalli involves an investment of:

xa: **TCS** and **Cognizant** started operations in Vizag (2025-26).
Visakhapatnam = tourism **anchor hub** + new **AI and data-centre hub**.
IT & GCC Policy 4.0: workspaces in **Tirupati, Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada**.

The Antiquities and Art Treasures Act was enacted in 1972

n1eabfccfd37.x: FTAs in 2024 were 9.95 million. 20.57 million is international tourist arrivals (which include NRIs), 2,947.63 million is domestic tourist visits, and 8.46 crore is the number of tourism jobs, not arrivals.

n2121e4c2566.s: How many new sites were identified for the national-importance tag in 2022?

Srisailam, Belum Caves, Annavaram and Markapuram

n33377c3782a.x: ‘Apni Dharohar, Apni Pehchaan’ is the Adopt a Heritage scheme, launched in 2017.
n33377c3782a.tq: Discriminate between similarly themed heritage schemes by their official title.
xs: "**Apni Dharohar, Apni Pehchaan**" is the **Adopt a Heritage** scheme (**2017**) — option **(1)** is correct.
Under it, **companies adopt sites** to maintain amenities.
xa: **Adarsh Smarak** (2014-15) = model monuments.
**HRIDAY** = heritage city development; **Travel for LiFE** = eco-responsible travel.

n211b0c7978c.s: Which temple of Andhra Pradesh has both a Jyotirlinga and a Shakti Peetha?
n211b0c7978c.x: Srisailam has the Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga and the Bhramaramba Shakti Peetha.
xa: Srisailam is in **Nandyal** dist., in the **Nallamala** hills on the **Krishna**.
⚠ Hills: **Seshachalam** = Tirumala; **Indrakeeladri** = Kanaka Durga; **Ratnagiri** = Annavaram.

n9c5e78b5117.s: The Simhachalam temple is especially noted for which combination of features?
o: Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga and Bhramaramba Shakti Peetha
Nine Narasimha shrines and a growing Nandi
Satyanarayana Swamy and the Pampa river
Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha, 96 black-stone pillars and the Chandanotsavam tradition
n9c5e78b5117.x: Simhachalam is dedicated to Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha, has 96 black-stone pillars, and its idol is uncovered from sandal paste during Chandanotsavam.
n9c5e78b5117.tq: Combine the distinctive architectural, ritual and deity clues of one site.
xs: **Simhachalam** = **Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha**, **96 black-stone pillars**, idol in sandal paste uncovered on **Chandanotsavam** — option **(4)** is correct.
**Mallikarjuna/Bhramaramba** = **Srisailam**; **nine Narasimha shrines** = **Ahobilam**; **growing Nandi** = **Yaganti**; **Satyanarayana Swamy/Pampa** = **Annavaram**.
xa: Simhachalam is in **Visakhapatnam** on Simhachalam hill.
It is one of AP's **PRASHAD** sites, with **Tirupati, Srisailam, Annavaram**.

ne7d5c76fbb8.s: Ahobilam, known for its nine Narasimha shrines, is in which district?
ne7d5c76fbb8.x: Ahobilam, with nine Narasimha shrines, is in Nandyal district.
xa: **Yaganti** sits in the **Erramala** hills, with a growing Nandi.
**Annavaram** is on **Ratnagiri** hill, on the **Pampa**.

o: Pilgrimage Restoration and Sustainable Heritage Area Development
Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual, Heritage Augmentation Drive
Public Recreation and Spiritual Heritage Development
Pilgrimage Renewal and Sacred Heritage Development
neb01b993488.x: PRASHAD expands to Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual, Heritage Augmentation Drive.
neb01b993488.tq: Test the exact official expansion, where look-alike words form the distractors.
xs: **PRASHAD** = **Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual, Heritage Augmentation Drive** — option **(2)** is correct.
It was launched in **2014-15** for **pilgrimage sites**.
xa: **54 projects**, ₹**1,726.74** cr; AP sites: **Tirupati, Srisailam, Simhachalam, Annavaram**.
⚠ **PRASHAD = pilgrimage** vs **Swadesh Darshan = thematic circuits**.
**NIDHI** = National Integrated Database of Hospitality Industry.

n142a3cb5453.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the seven anchor hubs identified for Andhra Pradesh tourism?
n142a3cb5453.x: The seven anchor hubs are Visakhapatnam, Tirupati, Araku, Rajahmundry, Amaravati, Srisailam and Gandikota. Kakinada is not included in this list.
n142a3cb5453.tq: Find the place outside the fixed seven-member list.
xs: **Kakinada** is not an anchor hub — option **(3)** is correct.
The **7 anchor hubs**: **Visakhapatnam, Tirupati, Araku, Rajahmundry, Amaravati, Srisailam, Gandikota**.
xa: **Kakinada** has **Uppada** beach.
**Rajahmundry** = river hub; **Gandikota** = heritage, adventure; **Srisailam** = pilgrimage, eco.

n594931367f7.s: The AP Tourism Policy 2024–29 plans more than how many thematic tourism circuits?
n594931367f7.x: The policy plans more than 25 thematic circuits, including Buddhist, temple, beach and river-cruise circuits.
xa: Incentives: up to **25% fixed capital subsidy**, industrial power tariff, **100% net SGST reimbursement**.
Investment proposals: **₹19,693 crore**; ~**8,000** hotel rooms.

n3938a0c26bb.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Tourism Policy 2024-29, which of the following incentives is offered to tourism projects?
o: Up to 25% fixed capital subsidy and 100% net SGST reimbursement
Up to 50% fixed capital subsidy and 50% SGST reimbursement
Commercial power tariff and full income-tax exemption
Up to 15% fixed capital subsidy only
n3938a0c26bb.x: The policy grants industry status and offers up to 25% fixed capital subsidy, industrial power tariff and 100% net SGST reimbursement. The 50%, 15% and income-tax options are not in the policy, and tourism gets the industrial (not commercial) power tariff.
n3938a0c26bb.tq: AP Tourism 2024-29: 25% capital subsidy + 100% SGST + industrial tariff.
xs: Incentives: up to **25% fixed capital subsidy** and **100% net SGST reimbursement** — option **(1)** is correct.
Tourism gets the **industrial power tariff**, not commercial; no **50%** or **15%** subsidy figures are given.
xa: Tourism and hospitality get **industry status**.
Investment proposals: **₹19,693 crore**; ~**8,000** hotel rooms.

n2b13768c27e.s: Srikalahasti temple is associated with which river?
n2b13768c27e.x: Srikalahasti is situated on the Swarnamukhi river.
n2b13768c27e.tq: Discriminate among the rivers associated with the listed temple sites.
xs: **Srikalahasti** is on the **Swarnamukhi** river — option **(3)** is correct.
**Pampa** = **Annavaram**; **Krishna** = **Srisailam** and **Kanaka Durga**.
xa: Srikalahasti has the **Vayu linga**; it is in **Tirupati** dist.
**Tirumala** = Sri Venkateswara, **Seshachalam** hills.

nb564a3dff64.s: Which hill station of Andhra Pradesh, near Madanapalle in Annamayya district, is called 'Andhra Ooty'?
nb564a3dff64.x: Horsley Hills near Madanapalle (Annamayya) is 'Andhra Ooty'. Lambasingi is the 'Kashmir of Andhra Pradesh', Araku Valley is a coffee and tribal hub (anchor hub), and Maredumilli is a forest area in Polavaram district.
nb564a3dff64.tq: Horsley Hills = Andhra Ooty; Lambasingi = Kashmir of AP.
xs: **Horsley Hills** near **Madanapalle** (**Annamayya**) is "**Andhra Ooty**" — option **(3)** is correct.
**Lambasingi** = "**Kashmir of AP**"; **Araku** = coffee and tribal hub; **Maredumilli** = forests in **Polavaram** dist.
xa: Proposed circuit: **Gandikota-Horsley Hills-Talakona**.
⚠ The real **Ooty** is in **Tamil Nadu**.

n749d2ba6e47.s: Gandikota, called the 'Grand Canyon of India', is a fort on the gorge of which river, in which district?
n749d2ba6e47.x: Gandikota fort stands on the Penna (Pennar) gorge in YSR Kadapa district and is one of the seven anchor hubs (heritage, adventure). Krishna/NTR is Kondapalli and Kanaka Durga country; the Godavari gorge has Papikondalu; Tungabhadra/Kurnool is not where Gandikota is.
n749d2ba6e47.tq: Gandikota = Penna gorge, Kadapa, 'Grand Canyon of India'.
xs: **Gandikota** fort stands on the **Penna** gorge in **YSR Kadapa** — option **(2)** is correct.
**Krishna/NTR** = **Kondapalli**; the **Godavari** gorge has **Papikondalu**.
xa: Gandikota is one of the **7 anchor hubs** (**heritage, adventure**).
Proposed circuit: **Gandikota-Horsley Hills-Talakona**.

n7ccd0ffd5a5.s: The Maratha Military Landscapes of India, inscribed in 2025, comprise:
o: 12 forts, including 11 in Maharashtra and Gingee in Tamil Nadu
11 forts, including 10 in Maharashtra and one in Karnataka
13 forts, including two in Tamil Nadu and 11 in Maharashtra
n7ccd0ffd5a5.x: The Maratha Military Landscapes comprise 12 forts: 11 in Maharashtra and Gingee in Tamil Nadu. They were inscribed at the 47th session held in Paris in 2025.
n7ccd0ffd5a5.tq: Break a composite numerical statement into total, state-wise distribution and the exceptional site.
xs: The **Maratha Military Landscapes** (**2025**) have **12 forts**: **11 in Maharashtra** plus **Gingee** in **Tamil Nadu** — option **(1)** is correct.
So "all in Maharashtra", "11 forts" and "13 forts" are wrong.
xa: It became India's **44th** WHS at the **47th** session in **Paris**.
**45th**: **Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath** (**2026**, UP), at the **48th** session in **Busan**.
India now has **45 WHS** → **6th in the world**.

n833c6ab4aec.s: Which one of the following is the only Harappan site in India included in the UNESCO World Heritage List?
n833c6ab4aec.x: Dholavira is the only Harappan site in India included in the UNESCO World Heritage List.
n833c6ab4aec.tq: Use the exclusivity clue ‘only’ to identify the unique site in the group.
xs: **Dholavira** (Gujarat) is the **only Harappan WHS** — option **(1)** is correct.
It was inscribed in **2021**, together with **Ramappa Temple** (Telangana).
xa: **Lothal** (Gujarat) is the site of the **NMHC**, to be **Asia's largest maritime heritage museum**.
**2023**: Santiniketan (WB) and Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas (Karnataka).
**2024**: Moidams of the Ahom dynasty (Assam).

nb4baf8d6a0c.s: Which city became India’s first UNESCO World Heritage City?
nb4baf8d6a0c.x: Ahmedabad became India’s first UNESCO World Heritage City in 2017. Jaipur received the designation in 2019.
nb4baf8d6a0c.tq: Distinguish the first designation from the later designation of a similar heritage city.
xs: **Ahmedabad (2017)** is India's first **World Heritage City** — option **(4)** is correct.
**Jaipur** followed in **2019**.
xa: **Agra** has the **Taj Mahal** and **Agra Fort** (cultural WHS).
India has **45 WHS** (**Jul 2026**).

ne0871fe2e78.s: Akal Wood Fossil Park is located in:
ne0871fe2e78.x: Akal Wood Fossil Park is in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan; Siwalik Fossil Park is in Himachal Pradesh.
xa: **Pillow lava, Nomira** = **Odisha**; **Buxa Formation stromatolites** = **Sikkim**.
**National Fossil Wood Park** = **Tiruvakkarai**, Tamil Nadu.

n404188691e4.s: Belum Caves, declared a geo-heritage site by the GSI in 2025, are in which district?
n404188691e4.x: The GSI declared Belum Caves in Nandyal district, AP, a geo-heritage site in 2025.
xa: **Belum** = **2nd longest natural cave in India** (after **Krem Liat Prah**, Meghalaya); first recorded **1884** by **Robert Bruce Foote**.
⚠ **Borra** = **1807**, **William King George**.

n6fa2a63d9b8.s: Kothapatnam beach is near which town?
n6fa2a63d9b8.x: Kothapatnam beach is near Ongole (Prakasam district); Manginapudi is near Machilipatnam.
xa: **Suryalanka** = **Bapatla** (APPSC **2025** key).
**Kotha Koduru, Ramatheertham, Mypadu** = **SPSR Nellore**.

nb3b1088dd08.s: Rushikonda, a certified Blue Flag beach, is located in:
nb3b1088dd08.x: Rushikonda Beach is in Visakhapatnam and is a certified Blue Flag beach.
xa: **21 more beaches proposed, 9 shortlisted** for Blue Flag.
Other Indian Blue Flag beaches: **Shivrajpur** (Gujarat), **Chandrabhaga** (Odisha).

n45d08bd3c95.s: Kotha Koduru, Ramatheertham and Mypadu beaches are associated with which district?
n45d08bd3c95.x: Kotha Koduru, Ramatheertham and Mypadu beaches are associated with SPSR Nellore district.
n45d08bd3c95.tq: Recognise a grouped regional cluster instead of matching one beach in isolation.
xs: **Kotha Koduru, Ramatheertham and Mypadu** are in **SPSR Nellore** — option **(1)** is correct.
**Ramatheertham** and **Kotha Koduru** were in the APPSC **2024** key.
xa: **Krishna** dist. = **Manginapudi**; **West Godavari** = **Perupalem**; **Visakhapatnam** = **Yarada**.
⚠ New districts **Polavaram** and **Markapuram** change old district answers.

n0720cd0d905.s: The Annavaram temple stands on which hill?
n0720cd0d905.x: Annavaram is on Ratnagiri hill near the Pampa; Seshachalam is Tirumala, Indrakeeladri is Kanaka Durga and Nallamala is Srisailam.
xa: ⚠ **Erramala** hills = **Yaganti**.
**Srikalahasti** is on the **Swarnamukhi** river.

na02707d331a.s: Borra Caves were found in 1807 by:
na02707d331a.x: William King George of the GSI found Borra Caves in 1807; Robert Bruce Foote recorded Belum Caves in 1884.
xa: Belum (**Nandyal**) was declared a **Geo-Heritage Site** by GSI (**2025**).
Borra Caves are **karstic limestone** in the **Ananthagiri hills** (Araku), with Mesolithic cave paintings.
**Talakona** is the **highest waterfall** in AP; **Lambasingi** the **coldest place**.

n2a8782ba160.s: Lambasingi is popularly known as the:
n2a8782ba160.x: Lambasingi in Alluri Sitharama Raju district is called the “Kashmir of Andhra Pradesh” because of its near-freezing winters.
xs: **Lambasingi** is the "**Kashmir of Andhra Pradesh**" — option **(2)** is correct.
"**Andhra Ooty**" = **Horsley Hills**; "**Grand Canyon of India**" = **Gandikota**.
xa: It is the **coldest place in AP**, in **Alluri Sitharama Raju** dist.
**Araku Valley** nearby: coffee, tribal culture; anchor hub (**hill, eco**).

nf7e743bbb6c.s: The highest waterfall in Andhra Pradesh, located in the Sri Venkateswara National Park, is
nf7e743bbb6c.x: Talakona (Tirupati district) in Sri Venkateswara National Park is AP's highest waterfall. Kailasakona is another Tirupati-district waterfall but not the highest; Katiki (near Borra) and Ethipothala (Palnadu) are other AP falls, not the highest.
nf7e743bbb6c.tq: Highest AP waterfall = Talakona (SV National Park).
xs: **Talakona** (Tirupati) is the **highest waterfall in AP**, in **Sri Venkateswara NP** — option **(2)** is correct.
**Kailasakona** is another Tirupati waterfall, not the highest.
xa: The CM proposed a **Gandikota-Horsley Hills-Talakona** circuit (Jul **2026**).
**Lambasingi** = coldest place in AP.

n643fb40cf62.s: Lepakshi is situated in which district?
n643fb40cf62.x: Lepakshi is situated in Sri Sathya Sai district.
n643fb40cf62.tq: Direct district recall from a heritage-tourism location.
xs: **Lepakshi** is in **Sri Sathya Sai** district — option **(3)** is correct.
Its **Veerabhadra temple** on **Kurma Shailam** hill has the **hanging pillar** and India's largest monolithic **Nandi**.
xa: It has **Vijayanagara murals**; a **₹103.05 crore** proposal exists for Lepakshi.
**Penukonda** (Vijayanagara stronghold) and **Thimmamma Marrimanu** are also in Sri Sathya Sai.

n0bc0c1f57ac.s: The Veerabhadra temple at Lepakshi is famous for
o: a hanging pillar and India's largest monolithic Nandi
nine Narasimha shrines in the Nallamala
a Vayu linga on the Swarnamukhi river
n0bc0c1f57ac.x: Lepakshi (Sri Sathya Sai district) has the hanging pillar, India's largest monolithic Nandi and Vijayanagara murals. The 96 pillars and Chandanotsavam are of Simhachalam, nine Narasimha shrines are at Ahobilam, and the Vayu linga is at Srikalahasti.
xs: **Lepakshi**'s Veerabhadra temple has a **hanging pillar** and **India's largest monolithic Nandi** — option **(1)** is correct.
**96 pillars, Chandanotsavam** = **Simhachalam**; **nine Narasimha shrines** = **Ahobilam**; **Vayu linga** = **Srikalahasti**.
xa: It also has **Vijayanagara murals**; it is on **Kurma Shailam** hill.
Lepakshi is in **Sri Sathya Sai** dist.

n768742f4933.s: India's first submarine tourism project is being launched by Gujarat in collaboration with which organisation?
n768742f4933.x: Gujarat's submarine tourism project, off Dwarka, is being developed with Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited.
xs: India's first **submarine tourism** (Gujarat, off **Dwarka**) is with **Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd** — option **(3)** is correct.
This was the APPSC-G2 **2024** key.
xa: **Visakhapatnam** has the **INS Kursura** submarine museum.
**NMHC** at **Lothal** = to be **Asia's largest maritime heritage museum**.

nf9f5268ed25.s: The National Maritime Heritage Complex (NMHC), planned as Asia's largest maritime heritage museum, is being developed at
nf9f5268ed25.x: NMHC is at Lothal, Gujarat, by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways. Dholavira is a Harappan World Heritage Site, Visakhapatnam has the INS Kursura submarine museum, and Dwarka is the site of the submarine tourism project.
xs: The **NMHC** is being built at **Lothal, Gujarat** — option **(2)** is correct.
**Dholavira** = only Harappan WHS; **Visakhapatnam** has the **INS Kursura** museum; **Dwarka** = submarine tourism.
xa: NMHC is by the **Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways**.
MoU with **Netherlands** (**20 Dec 2025**) + framework with New Zealand's Maritime Museum.

n1e4d8c2aedf.s: The Statue of Unity is located at:
n1e4d8c2aedf.x: The Statue of Unity is at Kevadia, now also known as Ekta Nagar, in Gujarat.
xa: Dedicated to **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**; **182 m** tall.
Lies between the **Satpura and Vindhya** ranges; sculptor **Ram V. Sutar** (APPSC **2019** PYQ).

n6b6064fd152.s: Which of the following is NOT a member of the Char Dham of Uttarakhand?
n6b6064fd152.x: The Char Dham of Uttarakhand comprises Badrinath, Kedarnath, Gangotri and Yamunotri. Rameswaram is not part of this group.
n6b6064fd152.tq: Find the outsider in a geographically confined pilgrimage list.
xs: **Rameswaram** (Tamil Nadu) is not in the Uttarakhand **Char Dham** — option **(1)** is correct.
Char Dham: **Badrinath, Kedarnath, Gangotri, Yamunotri**.
xa: **Rishikesh** (Uttarakhand) = **Yoga capital of the world**.
Uttarakhand also has **Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers** (natural WHS).

n2905838300b.s: Kondapalli Fort is located in which district?
n2905838300b.x: Kondapalli Fort is located in NTR district. NTR district also contains Mogalarajapuram and Akkanna Madanna caves.
xs: **Kondapalli Fort** is in **NTR** district — option **(3)** is correct.
**Guntur** has **Kondaveedu Fort**; **YSR Kadapa** has **Gandikota**.
xa: A heritage trek is held there on **World Heritage Day**, **18 Apr**.
NTR district also has **Mogalarajapuram** and **Akkanna Madanna** caves and **Kondapalli toys**.

nbb011549e38.s: Kondapalli toys of NTR district are made from which soft wood?
nbb011549e38.x: Kondapalli toys use soft Tella Poniki wood; Etikoppaka toys of Anakapalli use lacquer and natural dyes.
xa: Both are **GI crafts**; GI status draws craft tourists.
A **Kondapalli toys fair** is held on **World Heritage Day**.

ne0c3dd75e0b.s: The term ‘energy-transition sources’ in the Indian energy context refers to which of the following combination?
ne0c3dd75e0b.x: Solar and wind are identified as energy-transition sources because they support the shift towards cleaner, non-fossil energy.
ne0c3dd75e0b.tq: Discriminate between transition sources and conventional fuels.
xs: **Solar and wind** are the **energy-transition sources** (APPSC **2025** key) — option **(3)** is correct.
**Coal, petroleum, diesel, kerosene** and **natural gas** are fossil fuels; **uranium** is nuclear fuel.
xa: **Solar energy** is not a fossil fuel; **wind** is renewable (APPSC 2025 keys).
India's solar capacity: **164.59 GW**; wind **58.14 GW** (Aug 2026).
Renewables have crossed **200 GW**.

n9c315874047.s: Coal meets about what share of India's primary energy needs?
n9c315874047.x: Coal meets about 55% of India's primary energy needs and produces over 70% of its electricity.
xa: Some notes give **509.74 GW** for installed capacity.
Coal's share **fell for the first time in 50 years**.

n8989991d671.s: Which is the largest component of India's renewable energy capacity?
n8989991d671.x: Solar (about 164.59 GW) is the largest RE component; wind is about 58.14 GW.
xa: Installed capacity: about **552 GW** (Aug 2026); **over 54%** non-fossil.
India is **3rd in RE capacity**; 3rd in solar, 4th in wind.
Targets: **500 GW** non-fossil by **2030**; **net zero by 2070**.
Coal still gives **over 70%** of electricity generation.

na0b9ee3bb79.s: The approximate wind-energy potential of India assessed at a height of 120 metres is:
na0b9ee3bb79.x: India's wind-energy potential at 120 metres is assessed at approximately 695.5 GW.
na0b9ee3bb79.tq: Test a specific potential figure with nearby numerical distractors.
xs: India's wind potential is **695.5 GW at 120 m** (**NIWE**) — option **(4)** is correct.
⚠ Don't confuse with installed wind capacity (**58.14 GW**) or geothermal potential (about **10,600 MW**).
xa: Installed wind: **58.14 GW** (Aug 2026); India is **4th** in wind.
Wind states: **Tamil Nadu** (**Muppandal**), Gujarat, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, AP.
Wind: **Gujarat 1st, TN 2nd** (2025).

n136de6928e8.s: Which of the following correctly represents India's global ranking in renewable energy, solar and wind capacity, respectively?
n136de6928e8.x: India ranks third in overall renewable-energy capacity, third in solar and fourth in wind capacity.
n136de6928e8.tq: Read the ranking sequence carefully and avoid reversing the last two categories.
xs: India is **3rd in RE capacity**, **3rd in solar**, **4th in wind** — option **(4)** is correct.
Some notes said **4th** in RE capacity (2025-26) — the current figure is **3rd**.
xa: Solar = **largest RE component** (**164.59 GW**).
Renewables crossed **200 GW**.

nbb71b275912.s: India's target for the share of natural gas in its energy mix by 2030 is approximately:
nbb71b275912.x: India aims to increase natural gas's share from about 6.7 per cent to 15 per cent by 2030.
nbb71b275912.tq: Compare the present share with the stated future target.
xs: The target is a **15 per cent** (**15%**) natural-gas share **by 2030** — option **(3)** is correct.
**6.7%** is the present share, not the target.
xa: Gas grid: **Pradhan Mantri Urja Ganga** (Jagdishpur-Haldia-Bokaro-Dhamra); network target over **32,000 km**.
Other targets: **500 GW** non-fossil by 2030; **net zero by 2070**.

nf007e872108.x: India's net-zero year is 2070; 2050 is the target of many developed countries.
xa: Natural gas share target: **15% by 2030**.
Battery storage target: about **47 GW** by **2032**.

n9fb9a3fe343.s: Under the Revised SHAKTI policy (May 2025), coal is allocated through how many windows?
n9fb9a3fe343.x: The Revised SHAKTI policy of May 2025 allocates coal through two windows.
xa: **SHANTI Act, 2025** repeals the **Atomic Energy Act, 1962** + **CLNDA, 2010** and admits private companies.
Rat-hole mining was **banned by the NGT in 2014**.

na32c88f7452.s: Most of India's hydroelectric potential lies in the basins of the:
o: Himalayan rivers – Brahmaputra, Indus and Ganga
na32c88f7452.x: The Himalayan basins hold most of the potential because of perennial snow-fed flow and steep gradients; Peninsular rivers are seasonal.
xa: Highest hydel potential: **Arunachal Pradesh**.
Hydro capacity: about **48 GW**; about **4 GW** added in **2025**.

n3f897c2664d.s: India’s hydroelectric capacity was approximately how much in June 2025?
n3f897c2664d.x: India’s hydroelectric capacity was approximately 48 GW in June 2025.
n3f897c2664d.tq: Test the reported installed-capacity figure directly.
xs: India's hydro capacity was about **48 GW** (June **2025**) — option **(3)** is correct.
About **4 GW** of hydro was added in **2025**.
xa: ⚠ **58.14 GW** is **wind** capacity (Aug 2026).
Highest hydel potential: **Arunachal Pradesh**.

na1c2652b4af.s: Off-stream closed-loop pumped storage projects no longer require concurrence from:
na1c2652b4af.x: Off-stream closed-loop pumped storage projects no longer need Central Electricity Authority concurrence.
xa: AP plan (CEA, **10 Aug 2026**): **7,370 MW** PSP + **3,931 MW** battery storage by **2035-36**.
⚠ PSPs: **Pinnapuram 1,680 MW** vs **Upper Sileru 1,350 MW**.

n6bcca6d6c43.s: Which State has the highest hydroelectric potential in India?
n6bcca6d6c43.x: Arunachal Pradesh, in the Brahmaputra basin with perennial snow-fed rivers and steep gradients, has the highest hydel potential. Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand and J&K are also Himalayan hydel States but have lower potential.
xs: **Arunachal Pradesh** has the **highest hydel potential** — option **(3)** is correct.
The **Brahmaputra** basin has **snow-fed** perennial flow and **steep gradients**.
xa: **Himalayan** basins (Brahmaputra, Indus, Ganga) hold most potential; Peninsular rivers are **seasonal**.
**Bhakra** (Sutlej) is in **Himachal Pradesh**.

n7c554dddae5.s: Besides the Atomic Energy Act, 1962, which law did the SHANTI Act, 2025 repeal while admitting private companies to nuclear power?
