The summit was at **Bharat Mandapam**, **9-10 Sep 2023**.

n7113f7eaaf0.s: MAHARISHI, an initiative launched under India's G20 Presidency, relates to:
n7113f7eaaf0.x: MAHARISHI is the millets research initiative; the G20 satellite is for climate monitoring and the Global Initiative on Digital Health also came under India's Presidency.
xa: The **Global Biofuels Alliance** was also launched at **G20 New Delhi, Sep 2023**.
India's proposals at **G20 2025** included the **Africa Skills Multiplier** and a **Global Traditional Knowledge Repository**.
**Digital Innovation Alliance** (G20 2025): **India, Brazil, South Africa**.

nb9a83a96fb9.s: The African Union was admitted as a permanent member of the G20 in 2023 and was fully operationalised at:
nb9a83a96fb9.x: The African Union's permanent membership in the G20 was fully operationalised at Johannesburg in 2025.
nb9a83a96fb9.tq: Distinguish the year of admission from the later operationalisation of membership.
xs: The **African Union** became a G20 permanent member in **2023** and was fully operationalised at **Johannesburg in 2025** — so option **(4)** is correct.
**New Delhi 2023** is where it was admitted, not where it was operationalised.
xa: Johannesburg (**20th G20**) was the **first G20 on African soil**.
Theme: "**Solidarity, Equality, and Sustainability**" (**Ubuntu**).
The U.S. skipped G20 2025.

n96a8c3a3df6.s: Russia, admitted to the G8 in 1998, was suspended after the Crimea episode in:
n96a8c3a3df6.x: Russia joined in 1998 (creating the G8) and was suspended in 2014 after Crimea.
xa: The **52nd G7** was at **Évian-les-Bains, France** (June 2026), hosted by **Emmanuel Macron**.
The **51st G7** was at **Kananaskis, Canada** (June 2025).
The **U.S.** hosts the **53rd G7** in **2027**.

nfb7969a27b8.s: What defence-spending commitment was endorsed at the 36th NATO Summit?
o: 2% of GDP by 2035, including no related spending
5% of GDP by 2035, including 3.5% core defence spending and related spending
5% of GDP by 2026, entirely for related spending
3% of GDP by 2030, entirely for core defence
nfb7969a27b8.x: The Ankara Summit endorsed defence spending of 5% of GDP by 2035, comprising 3.5% for core defence and related spending for the remainder.
nfb7969a27b8.tq: Break the headline percentage into its component figures.
xs: The **36th NATO** Summit endorsed **5% of GDP by 2035**, with **3.5%** core defence plus related spending — so option **(2)** is correct.
This is the **Hague commitment (2025)**; the other figures and dates are not in it.
xa: The summit was at **Ankara, Türkiye**, and adopted the **Ankara Summit Declaration**.
**36th NATO** is among the other **2026** editions with the **79th WHA** and **81st UNGA**.
The **G7 Évian** outcome dealt with critical minerals and the **Strait of Hormuz**.

naa814ff2787.s: The proposed “35 by 35” target is associated with which conference?
naa814ff2787.x: The “35 by 35” electrification target was proposed in connection with COP31, scheduled at Antalya, Türkiye, in 2026.
naa814ff2787.tq: Link a distinctive slogan to the correct edition of a recurring conference.
xs: The proposed "**35 by 35**" electrification target is linked to **COP31** — so option **(1)** is correct.
COP31 (**Nov 2026**) is at **Antalya, Türkiye**, with **Australia** presiding over negotiations.
**COP30** was at **Belém**, **COP29** at **Baku**, **COP32** (2027) will be at **Addis Ababa**.
xa: India **withdrew its bid** for **COP33 (2028)**; **South Korea** was the only other contender.
**UNFCCC**: **198 Parties**; secretariat **Bonn**.
At the **Bonn SB session** (June 2026), India pressed for dialogue on unilateral trade measures like **CBAM**.

ncd6c8bd2d44.s: The Paris Agreement was adopted on 12 December 2015 and entered into force on:
ncd6c8bd2d44.x: The Paris Agreement was adopted on 12 December 2015 and entered into force on 4 November 2016.
ncd6c8bd2d44.tq: Distinguish adoption and entry-into-force dates rather than treating them as one event.
xs: The **Paris Agreement** was adopted on **12 Dec 2015** and entered into force on **4 November 2016** — so option **(4)** is correct.
It came out of **COP21** at Paris.
xa: The **ISA** was also launched at **COP21 Paris 2015**.
India hosted only **COP8 (2002)**.

n23207352816.s: COP30 was held at Belém, Brazil, and was notable because it was:
o: The first COP held under the UNFCCC
The first COP held in a G7 country
The first COP held in Europe
The first COP held in the Amazon
n23207352816.x: COP30, held in Belém in November 2025, was the first COP held in the Amazon region.
n23207352816.tq: Identify the distinctive geographical feature of the venue.
xs: **COP30** (**Belém, Brazil**, Nov 2025) was the **first COP held in the Amazon** — so option **(4)** is correct.
It was not the first UNFCCC COP: **COP21** (2015) and **COP29** (2024) came before it.
xa: Outcomes: **Belém Political Package**, **Belém Action Mechanism** (just transition), **60 GGA indicators**.
There was no fossil-fuel roadmap, and the U.S. was absent.
**First CBD COP**: **Nassau, Bahamas, 1994**.
**First G20 on African soil**: **20th G20**, Johannesburg (2025).

n1951279c753.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about upcoming Climate COPs?
o: COP31 will be held at Antalya under Türkiye's presidency
COP31 will be the first COP held in the Amazon
Australia presides over the negotiations at COP31
COP32 will be held at Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
n1951279c753.x: The first COP in the Amazon was COP30 at Belém (2025); COP31 (Nov 2026) is at Antalya.
xa: COP31 has a proposed "**35 by 35**" electrification target.
India **withdrew its bid** for **COP33 (2028)**.
**UNFCCC**: **198 Parties**; secretariat **Bonn**.

n8c66d4d8c34.s: The East Asia Summit currently has:
n8c66d4d8c34.x: The East Asia Summit has 19 members, comprising 11 ASEAN members and 8 partners.
n8c66d4d8c34.tq: Split the total into its two components before selecting the matching composition.
xs: The **East Asia Summit** has **19 members: 11 ASEAN + 8 partners** — so option **(4)** is correct.
ASEAN now has **11** members (with **Timor-Leste**), so "**10 ASEAN**" options are outdated.
xa: EAS was founded in **2005** at Kuala Lumpur.
The **20th EAS** (2025) theme: "**Inclusivity and Sustainability**".
EAS chair rotates annually among ASEAN members.

n2dd5e5cc89d.s: The 18th and last SAARC Summit, after which the organisation remains suspended, was held at:
n2dd5e5cc89d.x: The 18th and last SAARC Summit was held at Kathmandu in 2014; SAARC remains suspended.
xa: SAARC is suspended over **India-Pakistan** tensions on cross-border terrorism.
The **SCO** chair is now **Pakistan** (**2026-27**, summit **Islamabad**).
**BIMSTEC's** next summit is planned in **Bangladesh**.

n25c7cf6ebbc.s: IBSA was founded in 2003 through the:
n25c7cf6ebbc.x: IBSA was founded in 2003 through the Brasilia Declaration.
n25c7cf6ebbc.tq: Associate the grouping with its founding declaration and year.
xs: **IBSA** was founded in **2003** by the **Brasilia Declaration** — so option **(2)** is correct.
**Johannesburg** and **New Delhi** gave the G20 2025 and BRICS 2026 declarations, not IBSA's founding text.
xa: The **IBSA Fund** is managed by **UNOSSC**.
**IBSAMAR** is the IBSA **naval exercise**.
IBSA leaders met on the sidelines of **G20 Johannesburg** (Nov 2025).

n362fdbdd90a.s: Which SCO declaration condemned the Pahalgam and Jaffer Express attacks?
n362fdbdd90a.x: The Tianjin Declaration (2025) condemned both attacks; the Bishkek Declaration (2026), one of 28 documents adopted, approved an SCO-CSTO-CIS roadmap. (Sequence not buildable: only two dated items.)
xa: Tianjin endorsed an **SCO development bank**.
Bishkek condemned **U.S.-Israel attacks on Iran** and terrorism "in all forms".

n67bb98e1b22.s: The 16th India-Japan Annual Summit (July 2026) was held in:
n67bb98e1b22.x: The summit was held in New Delhi, with PM Sanae Takaichi attending and a Joint Declaration on Economic Security covering five sectors adopted.
xa: The 16th India-Japan summit is listed among the other **2026** editions.
**18th BRICS** Summit: **New Delhi**, **12-13 Sep 2026**.
**11th Quad FMM**: New Delhi, **26 May 2026**.

n5c04cb708fa.s: The WEF Annual Meeting 2025, held at Davos, focused primarily on which of the following?
o: Global digital taxation and cryptocurrency regulation
n5c04cb708fa.x: The WEF Annual Meeting 2025 at Davos focused on AI governance and climate change.
n5c04cb708fa.tq: Use the venue-theme association to identify the correct summit outcome.
xs: The **WEF Annual Meeting 2025** at **Davos** focused on **AI governance and climate change** — so option **(2)** is correct.
Ocean governance was the **UN Ocean Conference** (Nice); the other topics are not given for Davos 2025.
xa: **WEF 2026** (Davos): Canada PM **Carney** spoke of a "rupture in the world order".
**Summer Davos** (New Champions) 2026 was at **Dalian, China**.
⚠ **Davos** = WEF annual; **Dalian** = Summer Davos; **Lyon** = One Health; **Nice** = UN Ocean Conference.

n284d287e4d3.s: The Davos Compact on Antimicrobial Resistance was launched at which event?
n284d287e4d3.x: The Davos Compact on Antimicrobial Resistance was launched at the WEF Annual Meeting 2026 in Davos.
n284d287e4d3.tq: Match the named initiative with the summit at which it was launched.
xs: The **Davos Compact on AMR** was launched at the **WEF Annual Meeting 2026** — so option **(4)** is correct.
The **79th WHA** adopted the **Global Action Plan on AMR 2026-2036**, a different document.
xa: ⚠ AMR: **Davos Compact** = WEF 2026; **Global Action Plan** = WHA79.
WHA79 (**Geneva**, May 2026) passed **13** resolutions.
**One Health Summit 2026** was at **Lyon** (G7 Presidency).

ndc0cf76e168.s: The 3rd UN Ocean Conference held in June 2025 was hosted at Nice and co-hosted by:
ndc0cf76e168.x: The 3rd UN Ocean Conference was held at Nice, France, in June 2025 and was co-hosted by France and Costa Rica.
ndc0cf76e168.tq: Distinguish the host venue from the two co-hosting countries.
xs: The **3rd UN Ocean Conference** (June 2025, **Nice**) was co-hosted by **France and Costa Rica** — so option **(3)** is correct.
It was the **3rd** edition, held in **June 2025**.
xa: ⚠ **Nice** = UN Ocean Conference; **Lyon** = One Health; **Davos** = WEF.
**9th Indian Ocean Conference**: **Mauritius**, Apr 2026.
**Summit for a New Global Financing Pact**: **Paris**, **22-23 June 2023**.

n6f561c030c2.s: At the World Artificial Intelligence Conference 2026, 29 countries agreed to form which organisation, headquartered in Shanghai?
n6f561c030c2.x: At WAIC 2026, 29 countries agreed to form the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organisation, abbreviated as WAICO, with its headquarters at Shanghai.
n6f561c030c2.tq: Expand the acronym from the event context and retain the headquarters detail.
xs: At **WAIC 2026**, **29** countries agreed to form the **World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organisation** (**WAICO**), HQ **Shanghai** — so option **(3)** is correct.
**WAIC 2026** was itself held at **Shanghai**.
xa: ⚠ **WAIC** = the conference; **WAICO** = the organisation to be formed.
The **AI Impact Summit** (New Delhi, **2026**) declaration reached **92** endorsements.
India joined **Pax Silica** (**35** signatories) at the AI Impact Summit.

n0e98143c3f1.s: The CII Partnership Summit 2025, held on 14–15 November 2025, was hosted at which place?
n0e98143c3f1.x: The CII Partnership Summit 2025 was held in Visakhapatnam on 14–15 November 2025.
n0e98143c3f1.tq: Combine the event date with its location to avoid confusing it with other Andhra Pradesh venues.
xs: The **CII Partnership Summit 2025** (**14-15 Nov 2025**) was held at **Visakhapatnam** — so option **(1)** is correct.
Its theme: "**Transforming Andhra Pradesh into a Trillion-Dollar Economy**".
xa: Outcome: **193 proposals**, **₹2,80,384 crore**, **5,01,746 jobs**.
The **AP-UAE Food Cluster MoU** (**Jul 2026**) followed a Davos 2026 commitment.

n70b57c22a90.s: What was the theme of the CII Partnership Summit 2025 held in Visakhapatnam?
o: One Earth, One Economy, One Future
Transforming Andhra Pradesh into a Trillion-Dollar Economy
Building a Digital India for the Global South
Andhra Pradesh as the Gateway to Southeast Asia
n70b57c22a90.x: The theme was “Transforming Andhra Pradesh into a Trillion-Dollar Economy.”
n70b57c22a90.tq: Discriminate the exact official theme from broad economic-development phrases.
xs: The **CII Partnership Summit 2025** theme was "**Transforming Andhra Pradesh into a Trillion-Dollar Economy**" — so option **(2)** is correct.
"**One Earth, One Family, One Future**" (not "One Economy") was the **G20 2023** theme.
xa: Venue: **Visakhapatnam**, **14-15 Nov 2025**.
Commitments: **₹2,80,384 crore** through **193 proposals**.

nc575f858a05.s: Following its Davos 2026 commitment, Andhra Pradesh signed a Food Cluster MoU in July 2026 with:
nc575f858a05.x: The AP–UAE Food Cluster MoU of July 2026 followed the Davos 2026 commitment.
xa: At **WEF Jan 2026**, Trump launched the **Board of Peace** (**27** members).
WEF 2026 also launched the **Davos Compact on AMR**.
AP's **CII Partnership Summit 2025** drew **₹2,80,384 crore**.

n1720e4152ab.s: The G20 Johannesburg Leaders' Declaration (2025) included the first standalone ____ declaration since COVID.
n1720e4152ab.x: The Johannesburg Declaration included the first standalone debt declaration since COVID and set up a Cost of Capital Commission.
xa: It also had a **critical-minerals** value-addition framework and **MDB reform**.
It was adopted **unusually early**.
**ACITI** (Australia-Canada-India) was launched on the sidelines of G20 Johannesburg.

n17e36c7d219.s: Which countries were the founding members of the Global Biofuels Alliance?
o: India, the United States of America and Brazil
Brazil, the United States of America and the United Kingdom
n17e36c7d219.x: India, the United States of America and Brazil were the founding members of the Global Biofuels Alliance.
n17e36c7d219.tq: Distinguish founding members from other major biofuel-producing countries.
xs: The founding members of the **Global Biofuels Alliance** include **India, the USA and Brazil** — so option **(3)** is correct.
It was launched at the **G20 New Delhi summit, Sep 2023**.
xa: **Jordan** joined the **ISA, CDRI and GBA**.
⚠ **ISA** = India + **France**; **LeadIT** = India + **Sweden**; **GBA** = India + USA + Brazil.
Also launched under India's G20: **MAHARISHI** (millets research).

nefc7bd18eeb.s: What was the theme of the 18th G20 Summit hosted by India at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi?
o: Building a Just World and a Sustainable Planet
One Earth, One Family, One Future
nefc7bd18eeb.x: India hosted the 18th G20 Summit on 9–10 September 2023 with the theme 'One Earth, One Family, One Future'.
xa: Headline outcome: **African Union** admitted as a permanent member.
Meetings were held across about **60** cities in all States/UTs.
⚠ **18th G20** = New Delhi **2023**; **18th BRICS** = New Delhi **2026**.

nd3cb80f3e6b.s: How many Quad leader-level summits were held during 2021–2024?
nd3cb80f3e6b.x: Six leader-level Quad summits were held in 2021–2024; none was held in 2025.
xa: The FMM was **Rubio's** first India visit, with no major breakthrough.
India has sought to host the Quad summit since **Jan 2024**.
The stalled Quad Leaders' Summit is a listed criticism.

nd79cda91e4a.s: The AI Impact Summit 2026, the first such summit in the Global South, was held at:
nd79cda91e4a.x: The summit was held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on 16–20 February 2026; its declaration was adopted by 92 countries and organisations.
xa: The **New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact** was first signed by **85 countries + 3 bodies**, incl. the U.S. and China.
Motto: "**Sarvajan Hitaya, Sarvajan Sukhaya**".
Structure: **7 Chakras** + **3 Sutras**; vision **M.A.N.A.V.**

n7376cc19630.s: LeadIT, co-chaired by India and Sweden at COP29 in Baku, is concerned primarily with:
o: Expansion of solar power in tropical countries
Digital public infrastructure for the Global South
Sharing benefits from digital sequence information
Transition of heavy industry, including steel and cement
n7376cc19630.x: LeadIT focuses on the transition of heavy industries such as steel and cement.
n7376cc19630.tq: Link the initiative to the sector named in its policy objective.
xs: **LeadIT** (India + **Sweden**, **COP29 Baku**) deals with the **transition of heavy industry**, such as **steel and cement** — so option **(4)** is correct.
Solar power is the **ISA**; DPI is the **Digital Innovation Alliance**; DSI benefit-sharing is the **Cali Fund**.
xa: ⚠ **ISA** = India + France; **LeadIT** = India + Sweden; **GBA** = India + USA + Brazil.
COP29 set the **NCQG: US$300 bn/yr by 2035**.
**Cali Fund** came from CBD **COP16** (Cali, Oct 2024; resumed Rome, Feb 2025).

n0836493de9f.s: Which of the following was NOT associated with the Belém Political Package of COP30?
o: A roadmap for the complete phase-out of fossil fuels
Belém Action Mechanism on just transition
60 indicators for the Global Goal on Adaptation
n0836493de9f.x: The COP30 outcomes included tripling adaptation finance by 2035, the Belém Action Mechanism and 60 Global Goal on Adaptation indicators. No fossil-fuel roadmap was adopted.
n0836493de9f.tq: Locate the precise exception among several outcomes from the same summit.
xs: **A roadmap for the complete phase-out of fossil fuels** was not part of COP30 — so option **(1)** is the answer; COP30 had **no fossil-fuel roadmap**.
The **Belém Political Package** did include the **Belém Action Mechanism** (just transition), **60 GGA indicators** and **triple adaptation finance by 2035**.
xa: COP30 (**Belém, Brazil**, Nov 2025) was the **first COP in the Amazon**; the U.S. was absent.
The **Tropical Forest Forever Facility** (Brazil-led, **US$125 bn**) came at COP30; **India joined as Observer**.
Criticism: **COP30 pledges** were voluntary.

n8ef47e22610.s: Which is the only UN Climate Change COP that India has hosted?
n8ef47e22610.x: India has hosted only COP8, held in 2002.
xa: India's COP33 withdrawal: Environment Ministry letter of **2 Apr 2026**.
**First CBD COP**: **Nassau, Bahamas, 1994**.
**COP30** = first COP in the **Amazon**.

n409c342bb2b.s: The headquarters of the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) is located at:
n409c342bb2b.x: UNEP is headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya.
n409c342bb2b.tq: Use the headquarters-location association for international organisations.
xs: **UNEP** is headquartered at **Nairobi, Kenya** — so option **(3)** is correct.
**Bonn** hosts the **UNFCCC** secretariat, **Geneva** hosts WHO/ITU/WTO/ILO, and **Paris** hosts **UNESCO**.
xa: ⚠ **Geneva** = WHO, ITU, WMO, WTO, ILO; **Rome** = FAO; **Nairobi** = UNEP; **Bonn** = UNFCCC.
The **IPCC** is sponsored by **UNEP + WMO**.
**Greenpeace** HQ: **Amsterdam**.

n6b650cca55e.s: The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) is headquartered in:
n6b650cca55e.x: WMO, like WHO, ITU, WTO and ILO, is headquartered in Geneva.
xa: ⚠ **Rome** = FAO; **Nairobi** = UNEP; **Bonn** = UNFCCC; **Paris** = UNESCO.
WTO DG: **Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala** (Nigeria); ILO DG: **Gilbert F. Houngbo** (Togo).
WHO DG: **Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus** (Ethiopia).
WMO SG: **Celeste Saulo** (Argentina).

nfc4a19a348c.s: Rafael Grossi and Rebeca Grynspan, candidates for UN Secretary-General in 2026, head respectively:
nfc4a19a348c.x: Rafael Grossi is Director General of the IAEA and Rebeca Grynspan is Secretary-General of UNCTAD.
xa: Other UNSG candidates: **Michelle Bachelet** and **Macky Sall**.
Their UNGA dialogues were on **21-22 Apr 2026**.
Grossi is from **Argentina**; Grynspan from **Costa Rica**.

n2fe4383990e.s: The ITU Council accepted India's bid to host which event in 2030?
o: World Summit on the Information Society
n2fe4383990e.x: The ITU Council accepted India's bid to host the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference 2030, known as PP-30.
xa: The ITU has an Area Office at **C-DOT New Delhi**.
Hosting **PP-30** is listed among India's leadership roles, with the **Kimberley Process** chair (**2026**).
ITU: **1865**, oldest UN agency; India joined **1869**.

nc5488710ee4.s: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) is jointly sponsored by:
nc5488710ee4.x: The IPCC is sponsored by UNEP and WMO. Its AR6 synthesis report was released on 20 March 2023, and its AR7 cycle began in July 2023.
nc5488710ee4.tq: Match the scientific body with its sponsoring organisations.
xs: The **IPCC** is sponsored by **UNEP and WMO** — so option **(4)** is correct.
Its **AR6** synthesis came on **20 Mar 2023**; the **AR7** cycle began in **July 2023**.
xa: The U.S. said it would quit the **IPCC** in **Jan 2026**.
**UNEP** is in **Nairobi**; **WMO** SG is **Celeste Saulo**.
The **ITPGRFA** ("Seed Treaty") is sponsored by the **FAO**.

n21e52cdaaa0.s: The International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture, also known as the “Seed Treaty”, is sponsored by:
n21e52cdaaa0.x: The ITPGRFA is sponsored by FAO and concerns plant genetic resources in harmony with the Convention on Biological Diversity.
n21e52cdaaa0.tq: Use the common name and objective to identify the sponsoring organisation.
xs: The **ITPGRFA** ("**Seed Treaty**") is sponsored by the **FAO** — so option **(4)** is correct.
It deals with **plant genetic resources**, in harmony with the **CBD**.
xa: FAO HQ: **Rome**; DG **Qu Dongyu** (China).
India was a **founding member** of the FAO.
The **IPCC** is sponsored by **UNEP + WMO**.

n4d19ee41e60.s: The Global Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance for 2026–2036 was adopted at:
n4d19ee41e60.x: The 79th World Health Assembly, held in May 2026, adopted the Global Action Plan on AMR 2026–2036.
n4d19ee41e60.tq: Match the initiative with the adopting international forum and year.
xs: The **Global Action Plan on AMR 2026-2036** (**GAP-AMR**) was adopted at **WHA79** in **May 2026** — so option **(2)** is correct.
**WHA78** (May **2025**) adopted the **Pandemic Agreement**; the **UNSC** met on AI risks in **July 2023**.
xa: The **WHO Pandemic Agreement** was adopted on **20 May 2025**.
**Bhutan** became the first in WHO SEAR to **eliminate dog-transmitted rabies** (**Sep 2026**).
WHO DG: **Tedros** (Ethiopia).

n4446eb220b6.s: In the WHO Pandemic Agreement negotiations, India backs which grouping?
n4446eb220b6.x: India backs the developing-country Group for Equity in the negotiations on the WHO Pandemic Agreement.
xa: The Agreement's **PABS annex** is still being negotiated.
Talks resumed in **Geneva** in **Jul 2026** after the **Ebola** outbreak.
The Agreement was adopted on **20 May 2025**.

nc6eafdbd5ca.x: India had 15 FTAs covering 27 countries as of June 2026.
xa: Latest ones: **UK CETA** (in force **15 Jul 2026**), **Oman CEPA** (**Jun 2026**), **EU FTA** (concluded early **2026**).
**TEPA** with **EFTA** came into force on **1 Oct 2025**.
**India-US**: a joint statement on a trade deal in **Feb 2026**.

n703ca5108a3.s: Foreign direct investment inflows in 2025 increased by 73% to approximately:
n703ca5108a3.x: FDI inflows increased by 73% in 2025 to approximately $47 billion.
n703ca5108a3.tq: Match the percentage increase with the correct resulting inflow amount.
xs: FDI inflows rose **73%** to **$47 billion** in **2025** (UNCTAD GITM) — so option **(3)** is correct.
**$4.2 bn** is India's **CAD** in Q1 FY27; **$135 bn** is record **remittances**.
xa: UNCTAD's **World Investment Report 2026** put global FDI at **$1.6 trn** (+**6%**).
Its theme: "**International Investment in a Turbulent Era**".
UNCTAD has published the World Investment Report since **1991**.

n01e4cbb006a.s: The WTO e-commerce moratorium lapsed in March 2026 after the failure of which Ministerial Conference?
n01e4cbb006a.x: The failure of MC14 and the lapse of the e-commerce moratorium were reported in March 2026.
xa: The **Bali Peace Clause (2013)** on public food-stockholding is still pending a permanent solution after **MC14**.
WTO criticism: **Appellate Body paralysis** and India blocking **IFD**.
The **WTO** (HQ **Geneva**) is headed by DG **Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala** (Nigeria).

n8fe7e5fe030.s: The Global Investment Trends Monitor is published by:
n8fe7e5fe030.x: The Global Investment Trends Monitor is a UNCTAD publication; it reported India's FDI rising 73% to $47 billion in 2025.
xa: UNCTAD's other reports: **World Investment Report** and **Digital Economy Report**.
**UN DESA** issues the **World Economic Situation and Prospects 2026**.
The **World Bank** issues **Global Economic Prospects** and the **World Development Report 2025**.

n8095fa23e01.s: Which convention governs the transboundary movement of hazardous waste?
n8095fa23e01.x: The Basel Convention of 1989 governs transboundary hazardous waste. It also includes a plastic-waste amendment and stronger rules relating to e-waste.
n8095fa23e01.tq: Match the convention to its core regulatory object and avoid confusing adjacent environmental treaties.
xs: The **Basel Convention (1989)** governs transboundary **hazardous waste** — so option **(3)** is correct.
**Minamata** (**2013**) is about **mercury**; **Stockholm** (**2001**) is about **POPs**.
xa: Basel has a **plastic-waste amendment** and **stronger e-waste** rules.
Stockholm lists **34** chemicals, recently **Chlorpyrifos** and **PFAS**.
Minamata: **dental amalgam** to be phased out by **2034**.

ne1d81363d35.s: The Basel Convention was adopted in:
ne1d81363d35.x: The Basel Convention dates from 1989, after the Chicago Convention (1944) and before Stockholm (2001) and Minamata (2013).
xa: **Vienna Convention** (**1985**) and **Montreal Protocol** (**1987**) fall between Chicago and Basel.
The **Water Convention** was adopted at **Helsinki** in **1992**.
The **Windsor Framework** (**2023**) is the latest in the table.

n2d2d0d7f40c.s: The BBNJ (High Seas) Treaty entered into force on:
n2d2d0d7f40c.x: Adopted in March 2023, the BBNJ Treaty entered into force on 17 January 2026; India has signed but not ratified it.
xa: BBNJ is a treaty under **UNCLOS**.
⚠ One NextGen note gives **18 Jan** for entry into force; the main date is **17 Jan 2026**.
India yet to ratify BBNJ is a listed criticism of India's record.

nd7de8f372a2.s: In India, treaties are concluded in the name of the
nd7de8f372a2.x: Treaties concluded by India are concluded in the name of the President. Article 253 empowers Parliament to legislate for their implementation.
nd7de8f372a2.tq: Apply the ‘who performs this constitutional function?’ method.
xs: In India, treaties are concluded **in the name of the President** — so option **(2)** is correct.
**Parliament** does not conclude treaties; under **Article 253** it legislates to implement them.
xa: ⚠ **President** = treaty concluded in his name; **Parliament** = implementing law (**Art. 253**).
The UNSG is appointed by the **UNGA** on the **UNSC's** recommendation (**Art. 97**).
India **did not sign** the **UN Convention against Cybercrime**.

nc6ce76d5075.s: Article 253 of the Constitution of India enables Parliament to
o: appoint the secretariat of every UN convention
ratify every treaty without executive action
withdraw India from any treaty without consultation
legislate for implementing treaties and international agreements
nc6ce76d5075.x: Article 253 empowers Parliament to make laws for implementing treaties, agreements and conventions with foreign countries or decisions made at international conferences.
nc6ce76d5075.tq: Apply the constitutional provision to the practical task of treaty implementation.
xs: **Article 253** lets **Parliament legislate to implement treaties** and international agreements — so option **(4)** is correct.
Treaties themselves are concluded **in the President's name**, so Parliament does not ratify or withdraw from them on its own.
xa: ⚠ **Art. 253** (India) = treaty-implementing laws; **Art. 97** (UN Charter) = UNSG appointment.
India signed but has **not ratified** the **BBNJ** Treaty.
India has ratified **four** of the **five** outer-space treaties.

n69658d0eb74.s: The General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) was signed in ____ and came into force in ____.
n69658d0eb74.x: GATT was signed in 1947 and entered into force in 1948.
xa: The **Uruguay Round** was the **8th round** (1986 to Marrakesh 1994) and created the **WTO** on **1 Jan 1995**.
The **Dunkel Draft** (1991) carried proposals of GATT DG **Arthur Dunkel**.
**TRIPS** = intellectual property rights; **TRIMs** = trade-related investment measures.
⚠ Some notes say GATT began with **110 countries**; the standard figure is **23 original parties**.

n2d92c0cef5b.s:
India's refusal to join which of the following has been defended as protecting policy space?
1. Investment Facilitation for Development
2. Cybercrime Convention
3. Pandemic Agreement
n2d92c0cef5b.x: India's refusals on the IFD initiative and the Cybercrime Convention were defended as protecting policy space; the Pandemic Agreement is a separate matter as its PABS annex remains incomplete.
xa: The **UN Convention against Cybercrime** (2024) is the **first global cybercrime treaty**; secretariat **UNODC**.
It opened for signature in **Hanoi, Oct 2025** (**72** signed); binding **90 days** after **40** ratifications.
The **WHO Pandemic Agreement** was adopted by the WHA on **20 May 2025**; India backs the **Group for Equity**.
India is yet to ratify **BBNJ** (signed, not ratified).

n191a1842b85.s: The 36-member Council is associated with which organisation?
n191a1842b85.x: ICAO, established in 1944 under the Chicago Convention, has a 36-member Council and is headquartered in Montreal.
n191a1842b85.tq: Match the distinctive numerical composition with the correct organisation.
xs: The **36-member Council** belongs to **ICAO** — so option **(1)** is correct.
ICAO was set up in **1944** by the **Chicago Convention**; it has **193** members and sits in **Montreal**.
xa: India was re-elected to the **ICAO Council** for **2025-28**.
UNESCO has a **58**-member Executive Board.
The **ITU** (**1865**) is the oldest UN agency.

nd299c547a7f.x: India was certified polio-free in 2014; 2016 is Sri Lanka's malaria-free year.
xa: **Cabo Verde**: malaria-free **2024**.
**Chile**: first in the Americas to eliminate **leprosy** (**2026**).
**Niger**: first in Africa to end **onchocerciasis**.

n65dbefb19d2.s: Which of the following countries joined BRICS from 1 January 2024?
o: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran and the United Arab Emirates
Argentina, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia and Egypt
Ethiopia, Saudi Arabia, Indonesia and the United Arab Emirates
n65dbefb19d2.x: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran and the United Arab Emirates joined BRICS from 1 January 2024. Argentina declined the invitation, while Indonesia joined in 2025 and Saudi Arabia's status remained unconfirmed.
n65dbefb19d2.tq: Use the exact admission date and separate invited, admitted and unconfirmed members.
xs: **Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran and the UAE** joined BRICS from **1 Jan 2024** — so option **(1)** is correct.
**Argentina** declined, **Indonesia** joined only in **Jan 2025**, and **Saudi Arabia** has not formally joined.
xa: The invitations were issued at **Johannesburg**, **Aug 2023**.
BRICS now has **10 members** plus **10** partner countries.
⚠ In a past PYQ on BRICS expansion, the key gave no single correct option.

ndb2f73bd7ef.s: India took over the chairmanship of the Kimberley Process on 1 January 2026 for the:
ndb2f73bd7ef.x: India, a founding member, took over the chair on 1 January 2026 for the third time; the Process has 60 participants (59 countries and the EU).
xa: The Kimberley Process (**2003**) certifies **conflict diamonds** through the **KPCS**.
It brings together **governments + industry + civil society** and has **no HQ**.
India's other leadership roles: host of **ITU PP-30** and founder of **ISA/CDRI/GBA**.

ndab5e72c684.s: The Secretariat of APEC is located in:
ndab5e72c684.x: APEC has 21 economies and its Secretariat is in Singapore; India is only an observer.
xa: At APEC 2025, **China** proposed **WAICO** for **AI governance**.
**Pax Silica**: a **U.S.-led** grouping on critical minerals, semiconductors and AI; **India joined Feb 2026**.
**BIMSTEC** chair in **2026**: **Bangladesh**.

n06fce80b86e.s: Which country was invited to join BRICS at Johannesburg in August 2023 but declined?
n06fce80b86e.x: Argentina declined; Egypt and Ethiopia joined on 1 January 2024 and Indonesia in January 2025.
xa: BRICS now has **10 members** plus **10** partner countries.
⚠ In a past PYQ on BRICS expansion, the key gave **no single correct option**.
BRICS had **20%** of world GDP but **11%** of IMF votes in **2011**.

n256af271e53.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the UN Convention against Cybercrime?
o: It is the first global cybercrime treaty, adopted in December 2024
It becomes binding 90 days after 40 ratifications
It was opened for signature at Hanoi in October 2025
n256af271e53.x: The Convention's secretariat is UNODC, not UNCTAD.
xa: **72** countries signed at Hanoi.
India **did not sign** (privacy, data sovereignty).
India's refusals (**IFD**, Cybercrime Convention) are defended as protecting **policy space**.

nbf8f6c21981.s: Which trade agreement has been described as the 'Mother of All Deals'?
nbf8f6c21981.x: The India-EU FTA is called the 'Mother of All Deals'; the India-UK CETA is the 'Gold standard' deal.
xa: The EU FTA runs with an **Investment Protection Agreement** and a **GI Agreement**.
It was concluded in **early 2026**.
**TEPA**: EFTA tariff lines cover **99.6%** of India's exports.

n62bd9c03580.s:
The India-EU FTA is to operate along with which of the following?
1. An Investment Protection Agreement
2. A Geographical Indications Agreement
3. A Nuclear Liability Convention
n62bd9c03580.x: The India-EU FTA is to operate with an Investment Protection Agreement and a Geographical Indications Agreement; no Nuclear Liability Convention accompanies it.
xa: It is called the "**Mother of All Deals**".
**90.7%** of India's exports become duty-free at once.
It was concluded in **early 2026**.

n06e3e52c6a6.s: IMF lending is primarily intended to address:
n06e3e52c6a6.x: The IMF lends only to members, mainly for balance-of-payments problems; the Rapid Financing Instrument gives quick liquidity without a full programme.
xa: The RFI is used for **disasters, pandemics and post-conflict** needs.
The **ESAF** had the softest terms among IMF facilities.
**France** was the IMF's first borrower; operations began on **1 Mar 1947**.
**SAPs** (1980s-90s) meant austerity, privatisation and devaluation.

n0d5d063fc69.s: Which country became the 10th member of the New Development Bank and its first from Central Asia?
n0d5d063fc69.x: Uzbekistan became the NDB's 10th member and the first from Central Asia; the NDB is headquartered in Shanghai.
xa: The NDB was set up in **2014** by the **Fortaleza Declaration**.
**Egypt** joined the NDB in **2023**; the bank has lent about **$43 bn**.
The **NDB** (with ADB) finances the **Delhi-Ghaziabad-Meerut RRTS**.
⚠ **Uzbekistan** = NDB **10th** member; **Bulgaria** = Eurozone **21st** member.

n2877a1bdcaa.s: Which country joined the New Development Bank (NDB) in 2023?
n2877a1bdcaa.x: Egypt joined the NDB (set up by the 2014 Fortaleza Declaration, HQ Shanghai) in 2023. Uzbekistan later became the 10th member and first from Central Asia. Argentina and Indonesia are BRICS-expansion names, not NDB entrants.
xs: **Egypt** joined the **New Development Bank** in **2023** — so option **(2)** is correct.
**Uzbekistan** joined later as the NDB's **10th member**, first from Central Asia.
**Argentina** was invited to BRICS in **Aug 2023** but declined; **Indonesia** joined BRICS in **Jan 2025** — neither is the NDB entrant asked.
xa: The NDB was set up by the **Fortaleza Declaration** (**2014**); HQ **Shanghai**.
Founders' vote cannot fall below **55%**; no country holds a veto.
The NDB has lent about **$43 bn**.

n1f4d164a6a2.s: The Delhi-Ghaziabad-Meerut Regional Rapid Transit System is financed by:
n1f4d164a6a2.x: The Delhi-Ghaziabad-Meerut RRTS is associated with NDB financing in collaboration with ADB and serves the National Capital Region.
n1f4d164a6a2.tq: Identify the correct lender partnership rather than a single-bank association.
xs: The **Delhi-Ghaziabad-Meerut RRTS** is financed by the **NDB with ADB** — so option **(1)** is correct.
**HUDCO** with the World Bank and ADB is linked to **Amaravati** funding, not the RRTS.
xa: NDB also funds **Major District Roads** in **Madhya Pradesh**.
The NDB (HQ **Shanghai**) has lent about **$43 bn**.
**AIIB** funds **Mumbai Urban Transport Project-III**.

n3b57afe60b3.s: Which WTO subsidy box covers trade-distorting domestic support that is subject to a cap based on de minimis limits?
n3b57afe60b3.x: Amber Box subsidies are trade-distorting domestic support measures and are subject to prescribed limits, including de minimis ceilings.
n3b57afe60b3.tq: Use the exact subject-function association to distinguish the subsidy boxes.
xs: The **Amber Box** covers **trade-distorting domestic support** and is **capped (de minimis)** — so option **(2)** is correct.
**Blue Box** = production-limiting support; **Green Box** = minimal/no distortion, **not capped**; **TRIMs** = investment measures.
xa: ⚠ **Amber** = capped; **Green** = not capped; **Blue** = production-limiting.
The **Peace Clause (Bali, 2013)** shields public **food-stockholding** even if Amber-box limits are breached.
The Peace Clause permanent solution is **still pending** after **MC14**.

n5b6d77c7c89.s: Support tied to production-limiting programmes is classified under which WTO subsidy box?
n5b6d77c7c89.x: Blue Box support is linked to programmes that limit production.
n5b6d77c7c89.tq: Discriminate between the closely related Amber, Blue and Green subsidy categories.
xs: Support tied to **production-limiting programmes** falls in the **Blue Box** — so option **(1)** is correct.
**Amber Box** = trade-distorting, capped; **Green Box** = minimal/no distortion; **TRIPS** = intellectual property.
xa: ⚠ **Amber** = capped; **Green** = not capped; **Blue** = production-limiting.
The **Uruguay Round** created the **WTO** (**1 Jan 1995**) and covered farm subsidies, services and IP.
**TRIMs** = trade-related investment measures.

n30ad2c93277.s: Under the WTO Agreement on Agriculture, Green Box measures are those that:
o: Have minimal or no trade-distorting effect
Relate exclusively to intellectual property rights
Are subject to annual reduction commitments
Are capped at a fixed share of production value
n30ad2c93277.x: Green Box support has minimal or no trade distortion and is not capped; IPRs fall under TRIPS.
xa: **Amber Box** = trade-distorting support, capped (de minimis).
**Blue Box** = support tied to production-limiting programmes.
The **Peace Clause** (Bali, **2013**) protects public food-stockholding.

nc78d5ed268c.x: TRIMs refers to Trade-Related Investment Measures.
nc78d5ed268c.tq: Separate look-alike WTO acronyms by their exact subject.
xs: **TRIMs** = **Trade-Related Investment Measures** — so option **(2)** is correct.
Intellectual property rights = **TRIPS**; trade-distorting farm subsidies = **Amber Box**.
xa: **GATT**: signed **1947**, in force **1948**, with the **MFN** clause.
The **Dunkel Draft** (**1991**) was proposed by GATT DG **Arthur Dunkel** during the Uruguay Round.
The **Uruguay Round** (8th round) created the **WTO** on **1 Jan 1995**.

n632610a9e1d.s: The WTO, created by the Uruguay Round, came into existence on:
n632610a9e1d.x: The Uruguay Round (eighth GATT round, begun 1986) led to the WTO on 1 January 1995.
xa: The Uruguay Round covered **farm subsidies**, **services** and **intellectual property**.
The **Dunkel Draft** (1991) carried proposals of GATT DG **Arthur Dunkel** during the round.
⚠ One source (APP) says the round ended in **1993**; the standard closing is **Marrakesh 1994**.
**GATT** itself was signed in **1947** and came into force in **1948**.

n9bd2a3d0766.s: The Peace Clause agreed at Bali in 2013 primarily protects developing countries from WTO disputes concerning:
n9bd2a3d0766.x: The Bali Peace Clause shields developing countries' public food-stockholding programmes from disputes over Amber Box limits until a permanent solution is found.
n9bd2a3d0766.tq: Apply the agreement to the specific policy situation it was designed to protect.
xs: The **Bali Peace Clause (2013)** protects developing countries' **public food-stockholding programmes** from WTO disputes — so option **(2)** is correct.
It applies even if their **Amber-box** limits are breached, until a **permanent solution** is found.
The permanent solution is **still pending after MC14**.
xa: **Amber box** = trade-distorting domestic support, **capped** (de minimis).
**Green box** = minimal or no trade distortion, **not capped**; **Blue box** = support tied to production-limiting programmes.
⚠ **Amber** = capped; **Green** = not capped; **Blue** = production-limiting.
**MC14** failed and the **e-commerce moratorium** lapsed (**Mar 2026**).

n05d2bafc811.s: Which combination best describes the structural adjustment programmes of the 1980s and 1990s?
o: Debt cancellation, disarmament and refugee resettlement
Public food stocking, tariff abolition and gold accumulation
Universal subsidies, nationalisation and currency appreciation
n05d2bafc811.x: Structural adjustment programmes commonly involved austerity, privatisation and devaluation; studies linked them to rising poverty and inequality in the Global South.
n05d2bafc811.tq: Identify the complete policy cluster associated with structural adjustment programmes.
xs: **Structural adjustment programmes (SAPs)** of the 1980s-90s meant **austerity, privatisation and devaluation** — so option **(3)** is correct.
Studies link SAPs to **rising poverty and inequality** in the **Global South**.
xa: The **ESAF** had the softest terms among IMF facilities.
The IMF lends only to **members** for **balance-of-payments** problems.
The **Rapid Financing Instrument** gives quick liquidity without a full programme (disasters, pandemics, post-conflict).

ncc4c9f2d030.s: The UNFCCC Secretariat is located in:
ncc4c9f2d030.x: The UNFCCC secretariat is in Bonn, with 198 Parties.
xa: NDB: **2014**, **Fortaleza Declaration**; founders' vote cannot fall below **55%**.
**Uzbekistan** is the NDB's **10th** member, first from Central Asia.
The U.S. was the first country to attempt formal withdrawal from the **UNFCCC** (**Jan 2026**).

n5dce554b3aa.s: Under Article 97 of the UN Charter, the Secretary-General is appointed by:
o: The Economic and Social Council on the recommendation of the Security Council
The UN Security Council on the recommendation of the General Assembly
The International Court of Justice on the recommendation of the General Assembly
The UN General Assembly on the recommendation of the Security Council
n5dce554b3aa.x: Article 97 provides for appointment by the UN General Assembly upon the recommendation of the Security Council.
n5dce554b3aa.tq: Apply the 'who would do this job?' method to distinguish recommendation from appointment authority.
xs: Under **Art. 97**, the **UN General Assembly** appoints the Secretary-General on the **recommendation of the Security Council** — so option **(4)** is correct.
Option (2) reverses the roles; **ECOSOC** and the **ICJ** play no part.
xa: The term is **5 years**, after **straw polls**; the UNSC held its first straw poll in **Aug 2026**.
**Guterres** demits office at end-**2026**; the successor starts **1 Jan 2027**.
Candidates: **Michelle Bachelet, Rebeca Grynspan, Macky Sall, Rafael Grossi**.

nedb215c4298.s: Khalilur Rahman, elected President of the 81st UN General Assembly (2026-27), is from:
nedb215c4298.x: Khalilur Rahman of Bangladesh was elected in the Asia-Pacific Group's turn, defeating the candidate from Cyprus.
xa: **Bangladesh** also chairs **BIMSTEC** in **2026**.
UNSG appointment: by the **UNGA** on the UNSC's recommendation (**Art. 97**).
The new UNSG's term begins **1 Jan 2027**.

nb14f7fccb7f.s: India's election to the UN Human Rights Council for 2026-28 is its:
nb14f7fccb7f.x: India was elected unopposed to the UNHRC for 2026-28, its 7th term.
xa: India was re-elected to the **ICAO Council** for **2025-28**.
India was elected unopposed to **four ECOSOC** subsidiary bodies.
The ITU accepted India's bid to host **PP-30** (**2030**).

n6ec9d08b1b9.s: The ‘Great Reset’ is an initiative of the:
n6ec9d08b1b9.x: The Great Reset was a World Economic Forum initiative launched in 2020.
xs: The **Great Reset** (**2020**) is an initiative of the **World Economic Forum** — so option **(2)** is correct.
**INTERPOL**, the **UNHRC** and the **WHO** are not its sponsor.
xa: At **WEF Jan 2026**, the **Davos Compact on AMR** was launched.
The **Colombo Process** is a forum of Asian **labour-sending** countries.
**Kimberley Process** (**2003**): conflict-diamond certification.

n1670a1a846a.s: The secretariat of the International Solar Alliance is located at:
n1670a1a846a.x: The ISA secretariat is at Gurugram; New Delhi hosts CDRI.
xa: The ISA is open to **all UN members**.
The U.S. said it would quit the **ISA** in **Jan 2026**.
**CDRI**: India (**2019**), secretariat **New Delhi**.

n76424a940cd.s: Under the Kigali Amendment, India will stop clearances for new HFC production beyond
n76424a940cd.x: India will stop clearances for new hydrofluorocarbon production beyond 31 December 2027 under the Kigali Amendment.
n76424a940cd.tq: Recall the precise deadline rather than the year of adoption of the parent protocol.
xs: Under the **Kigali Amendment**, India will stop clearances for new **HFC** production beyond **31 December 2027** — so option **(1)** is correct.
The decision was announced in **Apr 2026**; **2025**, **2026** and **2030** are distractors.
xa: Kigali is an amendment to the **Montreal Protocol** (**1987**), universally ratified (**197**).
⚠ **Vienna/Montreal** = ozone; **Stockholm** = POPs; **Minamata** = mercury.
**Minamata**: dental amalgam to be phased out by **2034**.

n7cee3cc02da.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the U.S. exit from international bodies announced in January 2026?
o: It included the UNFCCC, IPCC and IRENA
The U.S. was described as the first country to attempt formal withdrawal from the UNFCCC
UN Women and UNFPA were among the bodies exited
The International Solar Alliance was not among the bodies exited
n7cee3cc02da.x: The ISA was among the bodies the U.S. exited, along with UNFPA, UN Women, UNHRC and UNCTAD.
xa: The memorandum covered **66 bodies** (**35** non-UN + **31** UN).
**UNESCO**: the U.S.'s **third** exit, after **1984** and **2017**.
The **ISA** (India + France, COP21, **2015**) has its secretariat at **Gurugram**.

n7f044e738d3.s: Which of the following is the private-sector arm of the World Bank Group?
n7f044e738d3.x: The International Finance Corporation is the private-sector arm of the World Bank Group and has 184 members.
n7f044e738d3.tq: Identify the institutional mandate hidden among similar abbreviations.
xs: The **IFC** (International Finance Corporation) is the **private-sector arm** of the World Bank Group — so option **(2)** is correct.
The IFC has **184 members**.
The **IMF** is a separate Bretton Woods institution, not part of the World Bank Group.
xa: World Bank President: **Ajay Banga** (U.S., Indian-born).
The **IBRD** runs a **$1.5 bn** programme for India's **Green Hydrogen Mission**.
The World Bank publishes the **Global Economic Prospects**, the **Logistics Performance Index** and the **World Development Report**.

nf558e653379.s: India became the world's fourth-largest economy in 2025 in terms of nominal GDP, with a size of approximately:
nf558e653379.x: India was reported as the fourth-largest economy in 2025 with a nominal GDP of approximately $4.18 trillion, overtaking Japan.
nf558e653379.tq: Link the ranking with the specific nominal GDP figure rather than a trade value.
xs: India became the **4th largest economy in 2025** with nominal GDP of **$4.18 trillion**, overtaking **Japan** — so option **(4)** is correct.
The rupee's fall later pushed India to **sixth** (6th) in the IMF's ranking (**Apr 2026 WEO**, **$4.15 trn**).
xa: India was the **8th largest exporter** (**4.3%**) of commercial services in **2024** (WTO).
Record remittances: **$135 bn** in **FY2024-25**.
FDI inflows rose **73%** to **$47 bn** in 2025 (UNCTAD).

nde37800fb16.s: India's reported position in the IMF ranking after the fall in the rupee was:
nde37800fb16.x: India was reported to have slipped to sixth place in the IMF ranking after the rupee's fall.
nde37800fb16.tq: Distinguish a later ranking change from the earlier fourth-place nominal GDP report.
xs: After the **rupee's fall**, India slipped to **sixth** (6th) in the IMF's ranking — so option **(4)** is correct.
This was in the **Apr 2026 WEO**, at **$4.15 trn**.
In **2025** India had become **4th** (**$4.18 tn**), overtaking Japan.
xa: The **Apr 2026 WEO** cut India's FY27 growth to about **6.2%** (West Asia war).
The **Jan 2026** WEO update raised FY26 growth to **7.3%**.
The WEO projected global growth at **3.1%** (reference scenario).

n11bd271b250.s: Which country was India's largest import source in 2024–25 among the following?
n11bd271b250.x: China was India's largest listed import source in 2024–25, accounting for 15.73%, followed by Russia, the UAE and the United States.
n11bd271b250.tq: Compare the percentages rather than relying on the geopolitical prominence of a country.
xs: **China** was India's largest import source in **2024-25** at **15.73%** — so option **(3)** is correct.
It was followed by **Russia 8.85%**, **UAE 8.79%** and **U.S. 6.33%**.
xa: Russia was over **51%** of India's oil imports in **July 2026**.
India's **CAD** was **$4.2 bn** in **Q1 FY27**.
India was the **9th importer** (**3.4%**) of commercial services in 2024.

n9bb7f07941e.s: India's record remittances in FY 2024–25 were reported at approximately:
n9bb7f07941e.x: India received record remittances of approximately $135 billion in FY 2024–25.
n9bb7f07941e.tq: Distinguish the annual remittance total from the separate workers' remittance measure for FY26.
xs: India's record remittances in **FY2024-25** were **$135 billion** — so option **(3)** is correct.
**$110.47 bn** is a different measure: **workers' remittances in FY26**.
**$47 bn** is India's **FDI inflow** in 2025.
xa: **Gulf remittances** rose despite the war.
FDI inflows rose **73%** to **$47 bn** in **2025** (UNCTAD GITM).
India's CAD was **$4.2 bn** in **Q1 FY27**.

n8124535bc6b.s: Which institution projected India's growth at 6.6 per cent for 2026-27 in June 2026?
n8124535bc6b.x: The Reserve Bank of India projected India's growth at 6.6 per cent for 2026-27 in June 2026.
n8124535bc6b.tq: Match the agency directly with its forecast.
xs: The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** (Jun 2026) projected **6.6%** growth for **2026-27** — so option **(3)** is correct.
The **IMF** (Apr 2026) cut India's FY27 forecast to about **6.2%**.
**S&P** issues ratings (BBB), not this growth forecast.
xa: The World Bank's **GEP (Jun 2026)** also put FY27 at **6.6%** (from 6.5%).
**S&P** upgraded India from **BBB-** to **BBB** in **2025**.
Growth drivers: **strong private consumption** + public investment.

n580d1fe069c.s: Which organisation has published the World Investment Report since 1991?
n580d1fe069c.x: The World Investment Report has been published by the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development since 1991.
n580d1fe069c.tq: Match the report with its specialised international publisher and institutional history.
xs: **UNCTAD** has published the **World Investment Report** since **1991** — so option **(4)** is correct.
**UNEP** is an environment body (HQ **Nairobi**); the **World Bank** publishes the GEP; the **ILO** publishes Employment and Social Trends.
xa: WIR 2026: "**International Investment in a Turbulent Era**"; global FDI **$1.6 trn** (+**6%**).
UNCTAD SG **Rebeca Grynspan** (Costa Rica) is also a **UNSG candidate** (2026).
⚠ **WEO** = IMF; **GEP** = World Bank; **WIR** = UNCTAD.

n24da08b6d79.s: Sarnath became India's which numbered World Heritage Site in July 2026?
n24da08b6d79.x: Sarnath became India's 45th World Heritage Site in July 2026.
n24da08b6d79.tq: Use the exact ordinal number associated with the current-affairs development.
xs: **Sarnath** became India's **45th** World Heritage Site in **Jul 2026** — so option **(3)** is correct.
It is listed among the topic's current-relevance developments of 2026.

n733f883394d.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the radar configuration of NISAR?

S-band supplied by NASA and L-band supplied by ISRO
Both L-band and S-band supplied by NASA
Both L-band and S-band supplied by ISRO
n733f883394d.x: NISAR carries dual radar: NASA provides the L-band system and ISRO provides the S-band system.
n733f883394d.tq: Resolve the paired-band confusion by fixing one agency to each radar band.
xs: **NISAR** carries **L-band** radar from **NASA** and **S-band** radar from **ISRO** — so option **(1)** is correct.

xa: NISAR was launched on **30 Jul 2025** by **GSLV-F16** from **Sriharikota**.

NISAR is the **first ISRO-NASA joint satellite**.

n5020ea26267.x: NISAR observes glaciers, earthquakes, land subsidence and biomass, among other Earth-system features.

⚠ **NISAR** = **GSLV-F16**; **EOS-05** = **GSLV-F17**; **EOS-N1** = **PSLV-C62** (failed).

n578207ba50f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Gaganyaan mission?

n9ee11a6ff79.s: Which mission is described as India's first Earth-imaging satellite in geosynchronous orbit?
